field.name: CLKGATE_CHANNEL

field.name: AHB_BURST8_EN
field.description: Set this bit to one (default) to enable AHB 8-beat burst

field.name: SFTRST

register.name: DEVSEL
register.description: AHB to APBH DMA Device Assignment Register

register.name: DMA_BURST_SIZE
register.description: AHB to APBH DMA burst size

field.name: CH0
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 0. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH1
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 1. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH2
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 2. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH3
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 3. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH4
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 4. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH5
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 5. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH6
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 6. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

field.name: CH7
field.description: DMA burst size for GPMI channel 7. Do not change. GPMI only support burst size 4.

register.name: DEBUG
register.description: AHB to APBH DMA Debug Register

field.name: GPMI_ONE_FIFO
field.description: Set to 0ne and the 8 GPMI channels will share the DMA FIFO, and when set to zero, the 8 GPMI channels will use its own DMA FIFO

register.name: CH%s_CURCMDAR
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Current Command Address Register

field.name: CMD_ADDR
field.description: Pointer to command structure currently being processed for channel n.

register.name: CH%s_NXTCMDAR
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Next Command Address Register

field.name: CMD_ADDR
field.description: Pointer to next command structure for channel n.

register.name: CH%s_CMD
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Command Register

field.name: COMMAND
field.description: This bitfield indicates the type of current command:

enumeratedValue.name: NO_DMA_XFER
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers but terminate command before any DMA transfer.

enumeratedValue.name: DMA_WRITE
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers and then perform a DMA transfer from the peripheral for the specified number of bytes.

enumeratedValue.name: DMA_READ
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers and then perform a DMA transfer to the peripheral for the specified number of bytes.

enumeratedValue.name: DMA_SENSE
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers and then perform a conditional branch to the next chained device. Follow the NEXCMD_ADDR pointer if the perpheral sense is true. Follow the BUFFER_ADDRESS as a chain pointer if the peripheral sense line is false.

field.name: CHAIN
field.description: A value of one indicates that another command is chained onto the end of the current command structure

field.name: IRQONCMPLT
field.description: A value of one indicates that the channel will cause the interrupt status bit to be set upon completion of the current command, i

field.name: NANDLOCK
field.description: A value of one indicates that the NAND DMA channel will remain "locked" in the arbiter at the expense of other NAND DMA channels

field.name: NANDWAIT4READY
field.description: A value of one indicates that the NAND DMA channel will will wait until the NAND device reports "ready" before executing the command

field.name: SEMAPHORE
field.description: A value of one indicates that the channel will decrement its semaphore at the completion of the current command structure

field.name: WAIT4ENDCMD
field.description: A value of one indicates that the channel will wait for the end of command signal to be sent from the APBH device to the DMA before starting the next DMA command

field.name: HALTONTERMINATE
field.description: A value of one indicates that the channel will immeditately terminate the current descriptor and halt the DMA channel if a terminate signal is set

field.name: CMDWORDS
field.description: This field indicates the number of command words to send to the GPMI0, starting with the base PIO address of the GPMI0 control register and incrementing from there

field.name: XFER_COUNT
field.description: This field indicates the number of bytes to transfer to or from the appropriate PIO register in the GPMI0 device

register.name: CH%s_BAR
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Buffer Address Register

field.name: ADDRESS
field.description: Address of system memory buffer to be read or written over the AHB bus.

register.name: CH%s_SEMA
register.description: APBH DMA Channel n Semaphore Register

field.name: INCREMENT_SEMA
field.description: The value written to this field is added to the semaphore count in an atomic way such that simultaneous software adds and DMA hardware substracts happening on the same clock are protected

field.name: PHORE
field.description: This read-only field shows the current (instantaneous) value of the semaphore counter.

register.name: CH%s_DEBUG1
register.description: AHB to APBH DMA Channel n Debug Information

field.name: STATEMACHINE
field.description: PIO Display of the DMA Channel n state machine state.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: This is the idle state of the DMA state machine.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD1
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the first word of a command.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD3
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the third word of a command.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD2
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the second word of a command.

enumeratedValue.name: XFER_DECODE
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine processes the descriptor command field in this state and branches accordingly.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine waits in this state for the PIO APB cycles to complete.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD4
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the fourth word of a command, or waiting to receive the PIO words when PIO count is greater than 1.

enumeratedValue.name: PIO_REQ
enumeratedValue.description: This state determines whether another PIO cycle needs to occur before starting DMA transfers.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_FLUSH
enumeratedValue.description: During a read transfers, the state machine enters this state waiting for the last bytes to be pushed out on the APB.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: When an AHB read request occurs, the state machine waits in this state for the AHB transfer to complete.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Write transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master arbiter accepts the request from this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_REQ
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Read transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master arbiter accepts the request from this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: CHECK_CHAIN
enumeratedValue.description: Upon completion of the DMA transfers, this state checks the value of the Chain bit and branches accordingly.

enumeratedValue.name: XFER_COMPLETE
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine goes to this state after the DMA transfers are complete, and determines what step to take next.

enumeratedValue.name: TERMINATE
enumeratedValue.description: When a terminate signal is set, the state machine enters this state until the current AHB transfer is completed.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_END
enumeratedValue.description: When the Wait for Command End bit is set, the state machine enters this state until the DMA device indicates that the command is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Write transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master completes the write to the AHB memory space.

enumeratedValue.name: HALT_AFTER_TERM
enumeratedValue.description: If HALTONTERMINATE is set and a terminate signal is set, the state machine enters this state and effectively halts. A channel reset is required to exit this state

enumeratedValue.name: CHECK_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: If the Chain bit is a 0, the state machine enters this state and effectively halts.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_READY
enumeratedValue.description: When the NAND Wait for Ready bit is set, the state machine enters this state until the GPMI device indicates that the external device is ready.

field.name: WR_FIFO_FULL
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Channel's Write FIFO Full signal.

field.name: WR_FIFO_EMPTY
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Channel's Write FIFO Empty signal.

field.name: RD_FIFO_FULL
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Channel's Read FIFO Full signal.

field.name: RD_FIFO_EMPTY
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Channel's Read FIFO Empty signal.

field.name: NEXTCMDADDRVALID
field.description: This bit reflects the internal bit which indicates whether the channel's next command address is valid

field.name: READY
field.description: This bit is reserved for this DMA Channel and always reads 0.

field.name: END
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA End Command Signal sent from the APB Device

field.name: KICK
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Kick Signal sent to the APB Device

field.name: BURST
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Burst Signal from the APB device

field.name: REQ
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the DMA Request Signal from the APB device

register.name: CH%s_DEBUG2
register.description: AHB to APBH DMA Channel n Debug Information

field.name: AHB_BYTES
field.description: This value reflects the current number of AHB bytes remaining to be transfered in the current transfer

field.name: APB_BYTES
field.description: This value reflects the current number of APB bytes remaining to be transfered in the current transfer

field.name: STEP
field.description: Fixed read-only value reflecting the stepping of the RTL version.

field.name: MINOR

field.name: MAIN_STATE

field.name: BUSY
field.description: When asserted the GPMI is busy

field.name: UDMA_STATE
field.description: USM_IDLE = 4'h0, idle USM_DMARQ = 4'h1, DMA req USM_ACK = 4'h2, DMA ACK USM_FIFO_E = 4'h3, Fifo empty USM_WPAUSE = 4'h4, WR DMA Paused by device USM_TSTRB = 4'h5, Toggle HSTROBE USM_CAPTUR = 4'h6, Capture Stage, (data sampled with DSTROBE is valid) USM_DATOUT = 4'h7, Change Burst DATAOUT USM_CRC = 4'h8, Source CRC to Device USM_WAIT_R = 4'h9, Waiting for DDMARDY- USM_END = 4'ha; Negate DMAACK (end of DMA) USM_WAIT_S = 4'hb, Waiting for DSTROBE USM_RPAUSE = 4'hc, Rd DMA Paused by Host USM_RSTOP = 4'hd, Rd DMA Stopped by Host USM_WTERM = 4'he, Wr DMA Termination State USM_RTERM = 4'hf, Rd DMA Termination state

field.description: Always write zeroes to this bit field.

register.name: READ_DDR_DLL_CTRL
register.description: GPMI Double Rate Read DLL Control Register Description

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Set this bit to 1 to enable the DLL and delay chain; otherwise; set to 0 to bypasses DLL

field.name: RESET
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 force a reset on DLL

field.name: SLV_FORCE_UPD
field.description: Setting this bit to 1, forces the slave delay line to update to the DLL calibrated value immediately

field.name: SLV_DLY_TARGET
field.description: The delay target for the read clock is can be programmed in 1/16th increments of an GPMICLK half-period

field.name: GATE_UPDATE
field.description: Setting this bit to 1, forces the slave delay line not update

field.name: REFCLK_ON
field.description: set this bit to 1 will turn on the reference clock

field.name: SLV_OVERRIDE
field.description: Set this bit to 1 to Enable manual override for slave delay chain using SLV_OVERRIDE_VAL; to set 0 to disable manual override

field.name: SLV_OVERRIDE_VAL
field.description: When SLV_OVERRIDE=1 This field is used to select 1 of 256 physical taps manually

field.name: SLV_UPDATE_INT
field.description: Setting a value greater than 0 in this field, shall over-ride the default slave delay-line update interval of 256 GPMICLK cycles

field.name: REF_UPDATE_INT
field.description: This field allows the user to add additional delay cycles to the DLL control loop (reference delay line control)

field.name: COMPLETE_IRQ
field.description: This bit indicates the state of the external interrupt line

field.name: DEBUG_STALL_IRQ
field.description: DEBUG STALL Interrupt Status. Write a 1 to the SCT clear address to clear the interrupt status bit.

field.name: BM_ERROR_IRQ
field.description: AHB Bus interface Error Interrupt Status

field.name: COMPLETE_IRQ_EN
field.description: 1 = interrupt on completion of correction is enabled.

field.name: DEBUG_STALL_IRQ_EN
field.description: 1 = interrupt on debug stall mode is enabled. The IRQ is raised on every block

field.name: M2M_ENABLE
field.description: NOTE! WRITING THIS BIT INITIATES A MEMORY-TO-MEMORY OPERATION

field.name: M2M_ENCODE
field.description: Selects encode (parity generation) or decode (correction) mode for memory-to-memory operations.

field.name: M2M_LAYOUT
field.description: Selects the flash page format for memory-to-memory operations.

field.name: CLKGATE
field.description: This bit must be set to 0 for normal operation. When set to 1 it gates off the clocks to the block.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_CLKS
enumeratedValue.description: Do not clock BCH gates in order to minimize power consumption.

field.name: SFTRST
field.description: Set this bit to 0 to enable normal BCH operation

field.name: DEBUG_REG_SELECT
field.description: The value loaded in this bit field is used to select the internal register state view of KES engine or the Chien search engine

field.name: BM_KES_TEST_BYPASS
field.description: 1 = Point all SYND_GEN writes to dummy area at the end of the AUXILLIARY block so that diagnostics can preload all payload, parity bytes and computed syndrome bytes for test the KES engine

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Bus master address generator for SYND_GEN writes operates normally.

enumeratedValue.name: TEST_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Bus master address generator always addresses last four bytes in Auxiliary block.

field.name: KES_DEBUG_STALL
field.description: Set to one to cause KES FSM to stall after notifying Chien search engine to start processing its block but before notifying the bus master that the KES computation is complete

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: KES FSM proceeds to next block supplied by bus master.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: KES FSM waits after current equations are solved and the search engine is started.

field.name: KES_DEBUG_STEP
field.description: Toggling this bit causes the KES FSM to skip passed the stall state if it is in DEBUG_STALL mode and completed processing a block

field.name: KES_STANDALONE
field.description: Set to one, cause the KES engine to suppress toggling the KES_BM_DONE signal to the bus master and suppress toggling the CF_BM_DONE signal by the CF engine

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Bus master address generator for SYND_GEN writes operates normally.

enumeratedValue.name: TEST_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Bus master address generator always addresses last four bytes in Auxiliary block.

field.name: KES_DEBUG_KICK
field.description: Toggling causes KES engine FSM to start as if kick by the Bus Master

field.name: KES_DEBUG_MODE4K
field.description: When running the stand alone debug mode on the error calculator, the state of this bit is presented to the KES engine as the input mode (4K or 2K pages)

enumeratedValue.name: 4k
enumeratedValue.description: Mode is set for 4K NAND pages.

field.name: KES_DEBUG_PAYLOAD_FLAG
field.description: When running the stand alone debug mode on the error calculator, the state of this bit is presented to the KES engine as the input payload flag

enumeratedValue.name: DATA
enumeratedValue.description: Payload is set for 512 bytes data block.

field.name: KES_DEBUG_SHIFT_SYND
field.description: Toggling this bit causes the value in BCH_DEBUG0_KES_SYNDROME_SYMBOL to be shift into the syndrome register array at the input to the KES engine

field.name: KES_DEBUG_SYNDROME_SYMBOL
field.description: The 9 bit value in this bit field shifts into the syndrome register array at the input of the KES engine whenever BCH_DEBUG0_KES_DEBUG_SHIFT_SYND is toggled

field.name: POUTC
field.description: PWM Output Configuration. This bit field determines the mode of PWM output on the output pin.

enumeratedValue.name: HCTR_1

enumeratedValue.name: FWM_1
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO empty flag is set when there are more than or equal to 2 empty slots in FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: FWM_2
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO empty flag is set when there are more than or equal to 3 empty slots in FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: FWM_3

field.name: ROV
field.description: Roll-over Status. This bit shows that a roll-over event has occurred.

field.name: CMP
field.description: Compare Status. This bit shows that a compare event has occurred.

field.name: FIE
field.description: FIFO Empty Interrupt Enable. This bit controls the generation of the FIFO Empty interrupt.

field.name: RIE
field.description: Roll-over Interrupt Enable. This bit controls the generation of the Rollover interrupt.

field.name: CIE
field.description: Compare Interrupt Enable. This bit controls the generation of the Compare interrupt.

field.name: MAXMB
field.description: This 7-bit field defines the number of the last Message Buffers that will take part in the matching and arbitration processes

field.name: IDAM
field.description: This 2-bit field identifies the format of the elements of the Rx FIFO filter table, as shown below

enumeratedValue.name: IDAM_0
enumeratedValue.description: Format A One full ID (standard or extended) per ID filter Table element.

enumeratedValue.name: IDAM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Format B Two full standard IDs or two partial 14-bit extended IDs per ID filter Table element.

enumeratedValue.name: IDAM_2
enumeratedValue.description: Format C Four partial 8-bit IDs (standard or extended) per ID filter Table element.

field.name: AEN
field.description: This bit is supplied for backwards compatibility reasons

field.name: LPRIOEN
field.description: This bit is provided for backwards compatibility reasons

field.name: IRMQ
field.description: This bit indicates whether Rx matching process will be based either on individual masking and queue or on masking scheme with RXMGMASK, RX14MASK and RX15MASK, RXFGMASK

enumeratedValue.name: IRMQ_0
enumeratedValue.description: Individual Rx masking and queue feature are disabled.For backward compatibility, the reading of C/S word locks the MB even if it is EMPTY.

enumeratedValue.name: IRMQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: Individual Rx masking and queue feature are enabled.

field.name: SRXDIS
field.description: This bit defines whether FlexCAN is allowed to receive frames transmitted by itself

field.name: WAKSRC
field.description: This bit defines whether the integrated low-pass filter is applied to protect the CAN_RX input from spurious wake up

enumeratedValue.name: WAKSRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: CAN uses the unfiltered CAN_RX input to detect recessive to dominant edges on the CAN bus.

enumeratedValue.name: WAKSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: CAN uses the filtered CAN_RX input to detect recessive to dominant edges on the CAN bus

field.name: LPMACK
field.description: This read-only bit indicates that CAN is either in Disable Mode or Stop Mode

enumeratedValue.name: LPMACK_0
enumeratedValue.description: CAN not in any of the low power modes

enumeratedValue.name: LPMACK_1
enumeratedValue.description: CAN is either in Disable Mode, or Stop mode

field.name: WRNEN
field.description: When asserted, this bit enables the generation of the TWRN_INT and RWRN_INT flags in the Error and Status Register

enumeratedValue.name: WRNEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: TWRN_INT and RWRN_INT bits are zero, independent of the values in the error counters.

enumeratedValue.name: WRNEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: TWRN_INT and RWRN_INT bits are set when the respective error counter transition from <96 to >= 96.

field.name: SLFWAK
field.description: This bit enables the Self Wake Up feature when CAN is in Stop Mode

enumeratedValue.name: SLFWAK_0
enumeratedValue.description: CAN Self Wake Up feature is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: SLFWAK_1
enumeratedValue.description: CAN Self Wake Up feature is enabled

field.name: SUPV
field.description: This bit configures some of the CAN registers to be either in Supervisor or User Mode

enumeratedValue.name: SUPV_0
enumeratedValue.description: FlexCAN is in User Mode. Affected registers allow both Supervisor and Unrestricted accesses

enumeratedValue.name: SUPV_1
enumeratedValue.description: FlexCAN is in Supervisor Mode. Affected registers allow only Supervisor access. Unrestricted access behaves as though the access was done to an unimplemented register location

field.name: FRZACK
field.description: This read-only bit indicates that CAN is in Freeze Mode and its prescaler is stopped

enumeratedValue.name: FRZACK_0
enumeratedValue.description: CAN not in Freeze Mode, prescaler running

enumeratedValue.name: FRZACK_1
enumeratedValue.description: CAN in Freeze Mode, prescaler stopped

field.name: SOFTRST
field.description: When this bit is asserted, FlexCAN resets its internal state machines and some of the memory mapped registers

field.name: WAKMSK
field.description: This bit enables the Wake Up Interrupt generation.

field.name: NOTRDY
field.description: This read-only bit indicates that CAN is either in Disable Mode, Stop Mode or Freeze Mode

enumeratedValue.name: NOTRDY_0
enumeratedValue.description: CAN module is either in Normal Mode, Listen-Only Mode or Loop-Back Mode

enumeratedValue.name: NOTRDY_1
enumeratedValue.description: CAN module is either in Disable Mode, Stop Mode or Freeze Mode

field.name: HALT
field.description: Assertion of this bit puts the CAN module into Freeze Mode

enumeratedValue.name: HALT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enters Freeze Mode if the FRZ bit is asserted.

field.name: RFEN
field.description: This bit controls whether the Rx FIFO feature is enabled or not

field.name: FRZ
field.description: The FRZ bit specifies the CAN behavior when the HALT bit in the MCR Register is set or when Debug Mode is requested at ARM level

enumeratedValue.name: FRZ_0
enumeratedValue.description: Not enabled to enter Freeze Mode

field.name: MDIS
field.description: This bit controls whether CAN is enabled or not

field.name: PROPSEG
field.description: This 3-bit field defines the length of the Propagation Segment in the bit time

field.name: LOM
field.description: This bit configures CAN to operate in Listen Only Mode

enumeratedValue.name: LOM_1
enumeratedValue.description: CAN module operates in Listen Only Mode

field.name: LBUF
field.description: This bit defines the ordering mechanism for Message Buffer transmission

enumeratedValue.name: LBUF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Buffer with highest priority is transmitted first

enumeratedValue.name: LBUF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Lowest number buffer is transmitted first

field.name: TSYN
field.description: This bit enables a mechanism that resets the free-running timer each time a message is received in Message Buffer 0

field.name: BOFFREC
field.description: This bit defines how CAN recovers from Bus Off state

enumeratedValue.name: BOFFREC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic recovering from Bus Off state enabled, according to CAN Spec 2.0 part B

enumeratedValue.name: BOFFREC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic recovering from Bus Off state disabled

field.name: SMP
field.description: This bit defines the sampling mode of CAN bits at the CAN_RX

enumeratedValue.name: SMP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Just one sample is used to determine the bit value

enumeratedValue.name: SMP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Three samples are used to determine the value of the received bit: the regular one (sample point) and 2 preceding samples, a majority rule is used

field.name: RWRNMSK
field.description: This bit provides a mask for the Rx Warning Interrupt associated with the RWRN_INT flag in the Error and Status Register

field.name: TWRNMSK
field.description: This bit provides a mask for the Tx Warning Interrupt associated with the TWRN_INT flag in the Error and Status Register

field.name: LPB
field.description: This bit configures FlexCAN to operate in Loop-Back Mode

field.name: ERRMSK
field.description: This bit provides a mask for the Error Interrupt.

field.name: BOFFMSK
field.description: This bit provides a mask for the Bus Off Interrupt.

field.name: PSEG2
field.description: This 3-bit field defines the length of Phase Buffer Segment 2 in the bit time

field.name: PSEG1
field.description: This 3-bit field defines the length of Phase Buffer Segment 1 in the bit time

field.name: RJW
field.description: This 2-bit field defines the maximum number of time quanta One time quantum is equal to the Sclock period

field.name: PRESDIV
field.description: This 8-bit field defines the ratio between the PE clock frequency and the Serial Clock (Sclock) frequency

field.name: MG
field.description: These bits mask the Mailbox filter bits as shown in the figure above

enumeratedValue.name: MG_0
enumeratedValue.description: the corresponding bit in the filter is "don't care"

enumeratedValue.name: MG_1
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding bit in the filter is checked against the one received

field.name: RX14M
field.description: These bits mask Mailbox 14 filter bits in the same fashion as RXMGMASK masks other Mailboxes filters (see RXMGMASKRx Mailboxes Global Mask Register )

enumeratedValue.name: RX14M_0
enumeratedValue.description: the corresponding bit in the filter is "don't care"

enumeratedValue.name: RX14M_1
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding bit in the filter is checked

field.name: RX15M
field.description: These bits mask Mailbox 15 filter bits in the same fashion as RXMGMASK masks other Mailboxes filters (see RXMGMASKRx Mailboxes Global Mask Register )

enumeratedValue.name: RX15M_0
enumeratedValue.description: the corresponding bit in the filter is "don't care"

enumeratedValue.name: RX15M_1
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding bit in the filter is checked

field.name: WAKINT
field.description: When CAN is Stop Mode and a recessive to dominant transition is detected on the CAN bus and if the WAK_MSK bit in the MCR Register is set, an interrupt is generated to the ARM

enumeratedValue.name: WAKINT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates a recessive to dominant transition received on the CAN bus when the CAN module is in Stop Mode

field.name: ERRINT
field.description: This bit indicates that at least one of the Error Bits (bits 15-10) is set

enumeratedValue.name: ERRINT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates setting of any Error Bit in the Error and Status Register

field.name: BOFFINT
field.description: This bit is set when CAN enters 'Bus Off' state

field.name: RX
field.description: This bit indicates if FlexCAN is receiving a message. Refer to .

field.name: FLTCONF
field.description: If the LOM bit in the Control Register is asserted, after some delay that depends on the CAN bit timing the FLT_CONF field will indicate "Error Passive"

field.name: TX
field.description: This bit indicates if CAN is transmitting a message.Refer to .

field.name: IDLE
field.description: This bit indicates when CAN bus is in IDLE state.Refer to .

field.name: RXWRN
field.description: This bit indicates when repetitive errors are occurring during message reception.

field.name: TXWRN
field.description: This bit indicates when repetitive errors are occurring during message transmission.

field.name: STFERR
field.description: This bit indicates that a Stuffing Error has been detected.

enumeratedValue.name: STFERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: A Stuffing Error occurred since last read of this register.

field.name: FRMERR
field.description: This bit indicates that a Form Error has been detected by the receiver node, i

enumeratedValue.name: FRMERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: A Form Error occurred since last read of this register

field.name: CRCERR
field.description: This bit indicates that a CRC Error has been detected by the receiver node, i

enumeratedValue.name: CRCERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: A CRC error occurred since last read of this register.

field.name: ACKERR
field.description: This bit indicates that an Acknowledge Error has been detected by the transmitter node, i

enumeratedValue.name: ACKERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: An ACK error occurred since last read of this register

field.name: BIT0ERR
field.description: This bit indicates when an inconsistency occurs between the transmitted and the received bit in a message

enumeratedValue.name: BIT0ERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one bit sent as dominant is received as recessive

field.name: BIT1ERR
field.description: This bit indicates when an inconsistency occurs between the transmitted and the received bit in a message

enumeratedValue.name: BIT1ERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one bit sent as recessive is received as dominant

field.name: RWRNINT
field.description: If the WRN_EN bit in MCR is asserted, the RWRN_INT bit is set when the RX_WRN flag transition from '0' to '1', meaning that the Rx error counters reached 96

enumeratedValue.name: RWRNINT_1
enumeratedValue.description: The Rx error counter transition from < 96 to >= 96

field.name: TWRNINT
field.description: If the WRN_EN bit in MCR is asserted, the TWRN_INT bit is set when the TX_WRN flag transition from '0' to '1', meaning that the Tx error counter reached 96

enumeratedValue.name: TWRNINT_1
enumeratedValue.description: The Tx error counter transition from < 96 to >= 96

field.name: SYNCH
field.description: This read-only flag indicates whether the FlexCAN is synchronized to the CAN bus and able to participate in the communication process

enumeratedValue.name: SYNCH_0
enumeratedValue.description: FlexCAN is not synchronized to the CAN bus

enumeratedValue.name: SYNCH_1
enumeratedValue.description: FlexCAN is synchronized to the CAN bus

field.name: BUFHM
field.description: Each bit enables or disables the respective CAN Message Buffer (MB32 to MB63) Interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: BUFHM_0
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding buffer Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: BUFHM_1
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding buffer Interrupt is enabled

field.name: BUFLM
field.description: Each bit enables or disables the respective CAN Message Buffer (MB0 to MB31) Interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: BUFLM_0
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding buffer Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: BUFLM_1
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding buffer Interrupt is enabled

field.name: BUFHI
field.description: Each bit flags the respective CAN Message Buffer (MB32 to MB63) interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFHI_1
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding buffer has successfully completed transmission or reception

field.name: BUF4TO0I
field.description: If the Rx FIFO is not enabled, these bits flag the interrupts for MB0 to MB4

field.name: BUF5I
field.description: If the Rx FIFO is not enabled, this bit flags the interrupt for MB5

enumeratedValue.name: BUF5I_1
enumeratedValue.description: MB5 completed transmission/reception or frames available in the FIFO

field.name: BUF6I
field.description: If the Rx FIFO is not enabled, this bit flags the interrupt for MB6

enumeratedValue.name: BUF6I_1
enumeratedValue.description: MB6 completed transmission/reception or FIFO almost full

field.name: BUF7I
field.description: If the Rx FIFO is not enabled, this bit flags the interrupt for MB7

enumeratedValue.name: BUF7I_1
enumeratedValue.description: MB7 completed transmission/reception or FIFO overflow

field.name: BUF31TO8I
field.description: Each bit flags the respective CAN Message Buffer (MB8 to MB31) interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: BUF31TO8I_1
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding MB has successfully completed transmission or reception

field.name: EACEN
field.description: This bit controls the comparison of IDE and RTR bits within Rx Mailboxes filters with their corresponding bits in the incoming frame by the matching process

enumeratedValue.name: EACEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Mailbox filter's IDE bit is always compared and RTR is never compared despite mask bits.

enumeratedValue.name: EACEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the comparison of both Rx Mailbox filter's IDE and RTR bit with their corresponding bits within the incoming frame. Mask bits do apply.

field.name: RRS
field.description: If this bit is asserted Remote Request Frame is submitted to a matching process and stored in the corresponding Message Buffer in the same fashion of a Data Frame

field.name: MRP
field.description: If this bit is set the matching process starts from the Mailboxes and if no match occurs the matching continues on the Rx FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: MRP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Matching starts from Rx FIFO and continues on Mailboxes

enumeratedValue.name: MRP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Matching starts from Mailboxes and continues on Rx FIFO

field.name: TASD
field.description: This 5-bit field indicates how many CAN bits the Tx arbitration process start point can be delayed from the first bit of CRC field on CAN bus

field.name: RFFN
field.description: This 4-bit field defines the number of Rx FIFO filters according to

field.name: WRMFRZ
field.description: Enable unrestricted write access to FlexCAN memory in Freeze mode

enumeratedValue.name: WRMFRZ_0
enumeratedValue.description: Keep the write access restricted in some regions of FlexCAN memory

enumeratedValue.name: WRMFRZ_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable unrestricted write access to FlexCAN memory

field.name: IMB
field.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, this bit indicates whether there is any inactive Mailbox (CODE field is either 0b1000 or 0b0000)

enumeratedValue.name: IMB_0
enumeratedValue.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, the ESR2[LPTM] is not an inactive Mailbox.

enumeratedValue.name: IMB_1
enumeratedValue.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, there is at least one inactive Mailbox. LPTM content is the number of the first one.

field.name: VPS
field.description: This bit indicates whether IMB and LPTM contents are currently valid or not

enumeratedValue.name: VPS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are invalid

enumeratedValue.name: VPS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are valid

field.name: LPTM
field.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, his 7-bit field indicates the lowest number inactive Mailbox (refer to IMB bit description)

field.name: TXCRC
field.description: This field indicates the CRC value of the last message transmitted

field.name: MBCRC
field.description: This field indicates the number of the Mailbox corresponding to the value in TXCRC field.

field.name: FGM
field.description: These bits mask the ID Filter Table elements bits in a perfect alignment

enumeratedValue.name: FGM_0
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding bit in the filter is "don't care"

enumeratedValue.name: FGM_1
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding bit in the filter is checked

field.name: IDHIT
field.description: This 9-bit field indicates which Identifier Acceptance Filter (see Rx FIFO Structure) was hit by the received message that is in the output of the Rx FIFO

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding bit in the filter is checked

field.name: GFWR
field.description: It determines the Glitch Filter Width

enumeratedValue.name: ENMOD_0
enumeratedValue.description: GPT counter will retain its value when it is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENMOD_1
enumeratedValue.description: GPT counter value is reset to 0 when it is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DBGEN_0

enumeratedValue.name: DBGEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is enabled in debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WAITEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is disabled in wait mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WAITEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is enabled in wait mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is disabled in doze mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is enabled in doze mode.

enumeratedValue.name: STOPEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is disabled in Stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: STOPEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is enabled in Stop mode.

field.name: EN_24M
field.description: Enable 24 MHz clock input from crystal

enumeratedValue.name: SWR_0
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is not in reset state

field.name: IM2
field.description: IM2 (bits 19-18, Input Capture Channel 2 operating mode) IM1 (bits 17-16, Input Capture Channel 1 operating mode) The IMn bit field determines the transition on the input pin (for Input capture channel n), which will trigger a capture event

field.name: OM3
field.description: OM3 (bits 28-26) controls the Output Compare Channel 3 operating mode

enumeratedValue.name: OM3_0
enumeratedValue.description: Output disconnected. No response on pin.

field.name: FO3
field.description: FO3 Force Output Compare Channel 3 FO2 Force Output Compare Channel 2 FO1 Force Output Compare Channel 1 The FOn bit causes the pin action programmed for the timer Output Compare n pin (according to the OMn bits in this register)

enumeratedValue.name: FO3_1
enumeratedValue.description: Causes the programmed pin action on the timer Output Compare n pin; the OFn flag is not set.

field.name: OF3
field.description: OF3 Output Compare 3 Flag OF2 Output Compare 2 Flag OF1 Output Compare 1 Flag The OFn bit indicates that a compare event has occurred on Output Compare channel n

field.name: IF2
field.description: IF2 Input capture 2 Flag IF1 Input capture 1 Flag The IFn bit indicates that a capture event has occurred on Input Capture channel n

field.name: OF3IE
field.description: OF3IE Output Compare 3 Interrupt Enable OF2IE Output Compare 2 Interrupt Enable OF1IE Output Compare 1 Interrupt Enable The OFnIE bit controls the Output Compare Channel n interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: OF3IE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Output Compare Channel n interrupt is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: OF3IE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Output Compare Channel n interrupt is enabled.

field.name: IF2IE
field.description: IF2IE Input capture 2 Interrupt Enable IF1IE Input capture 1 Interrupt Enable The IFnIE bit controls the IFnIE Input Capture n Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: IF2IE_0
enumeratedValue.description: IF2IE Input Capture n Interrupt Enable is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: IF2IE_1
enumeratedValue.description: IF2IE Input Capture n Interrupt Enable is enabled.

field.name: ROVIE
field.description: Rollover Interrupt Enable. The ROVIE bit controls the Rollover interrupt.

field.name: COUNT
field.description: Counter Value. The COUNT bits show the current count value of the GPT counter.

field.name: ISR
field.description: Interrupt status bits - Bit n of this register is asserted (active high) when the active condition (as determined by the corresponding ICR bit) is detected on the GPIO input and is waiting for service

field.name: MC_SL
field.description: Monotonic Counter Soft Lock When set, it prevents any writes (increments) to the MC registers and the MC_ENV bit

field.name: GPR_SL
field.description: General-Purpose Register Soft Lock When set, it prevents any writes to the GPR

field.name: LP_SWR
field.description: LP Software Reset When set, it resets the SNVS_LP section

field.name: LP_SWR_DIS
field.description: LP Software Reset Disable When set, it disables the LP software reset

field.name: NPSWA_EN
field.description: Non-Privileged Software Access Enable When set, it allows non-privileged software to access all SNVS registers, including those that are privileged-software read/write access only

field.name: HPTA_EN
field.description: HP Time Alarm Enable When set, the time alarm interrupt is generated if the value in the HP time alarm registers is equal to the value of the HP real-time counter

enumeratedValue.name: HPTA_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: HP time alarm interrupt is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: HPTA_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: HP time alarm interrupt is enabled.

field.name: PI_EN

field.name: BI
field.description: Button interrupt. The ipi_snvs_btn_int_b signal was asserted.

field.name: RTC
field.description: HP Real-Time Counter Most significant 32 bits

field.name: RTC
field.description: HP Real-Time Counter Least significant 32 bits

field.name: HPTA
field.description: HP Time Alarm Most significant 15 bits

field.name: HPTA
field.description: HP Time Alarm The least significant bits

field.name: MC_HL
field.description: Monotonic Counter Hard Lock When set, it blocks any writes (increments) to the MC registers and the MC_ENV bit

field.name: GPR_HL
field.description: General-Purpose Register Hard Lock When set, it blocks any writes to the GPR

field.name: MC_ENV
field.description: Monotonic Counter Enable and Valid When set, the MC can be incremented (by a write transaction to the LPSMCMR or LPSMCLR)

field.name: DP_EN
field.description: Dumb PMIC Enabled When set, the software can control the system power

field.name: TOP
field.description: Turn off System Power Asserting this bit causes a signal to be sent to the power management IC to turn the system power off

field.name: PWR_GLITCH_EN
field.description: By default, the detection of a power glitch does not cause the pmic_en_b signal to be asserted

field.name: BTN_PRESS_TIME
field.description: Button press timeout values for the PMIC logic

field.name: DEBOUNCE
field.description: This field configures the amount of debounce time for the BTN input signal

field.name: ON_TIME
field.description: The ON_TIME field is used to configure the period of time after the BTN is asserted before the pmic_en_b is asserted to turn on the SoC power

enumeratedValue.name: MCR_0
enumeratedValue.description: MC did not reach its maximum value.

field.name: EO
field.description: Emergency Off This bit is set when a power off is requested.

field.name: SPO
field.description: Set Power Off The SPO bit is set when the set_pwr_off_irq interrupt is triggered, which happens when the software writes a 1 to the TOP bit in the LPCR or when the power button is pressed longer than the configured debounce time

register.name: LPSMCMR
register.description: SNVS_LP Secure Monotonic Counter MSB Register

field.name: MON_COUNTER
field.description: Monotonic Counter Most-Significant 16 Bits The MC is incremented by one when: A write transaction to the LPSMCMR register or the LPSMCLR register is detected

field.name: MC_ERA_BITS
field.description: Monotonic Counter Era Bits These bits are the inputs to the module and are typically connected to the fuses

register.name: LPSMCLR
register.description: SNVS_LP Secure Monotonic Counter LSB Register

field.name: MON_COUNTER
field.description: Monotonic Counter bits The MC is incremented by one when: A write transaction to the LPSMCMR register or the LPSMCLR register is detected

field.name: GPR
field.description: General-Purpose Register When the GPR_SL or GPR_HL bit is set, the register can't be programmed.

enumeratedValue.name: KRE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Row is included in the keypad key press detect.

enumeratedValue.name: OPEN_DRAIN
enumeratedValue.description: Column strobe output is open drain.

enumeratedValue.description: An interrupt request is generated when KPKD is set.

field.name: REFTOP_PWD
field.description: Control bit to power-down the analog bandgap reference circuitry

field.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF
field.description: Control bit to disable the self-bias circuit in the analog bandgap

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Uses coarse bias currents for startup

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Uses bandgap-based bias currents for best performance.

field.name: REFTOP_VBGADJ
field.description: Not related to CCM. See Power Management Unit (PMU)

field.name: REFTOP_VBGUP
field.description: Status bit that signals the analog bandgap voltage is up and stable

field.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG
field.description: Configure the analog behavior in stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_0
enumeratedValue.description: All analog except rtc powered down on stop mode assertion. XtalOsc=on, RCOsc=off;

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Certain analog functions such as certain regulators left up. XtalOsc=on, RCOsc=off;

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_2
enumeratedValue.description: XtalOsc=off, RCOsc=on, Old BG=on, New BG=off.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_3
enumeratedValue.description: XtalOsc=off, RCOsc=on, Old BG=off, New BG=on.

field.name: DISCON_HIGH_SNVS
field.description: This bit controls a switch from VDD_HIGH_IN to VDD_SNVS_IN.

field.name: OSC_I
field.description: This field determines the bias current in the 24MHz oscillator

field.name: OSC_XTALOK
field.description: Status bit that signals that the output of the 24-MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: OSC_XTALOK_EN
field.description: This bit enables the detector that signals when the 24MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: CLKGATE_CTRL
field.description: This bit allows disabling the clock gate (always ungated) for the xtal 24MHz clock that clocks the digital logic in the analog block

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOW_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Allow the logic to automatically gate the clock when the XTAL is powered down.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Prevent the logic from ever gating off the clock.

field.name: CLKGATE_DELAY
field.description: This field specifies the delay between powering up the XTAL 24MHz clock and releasing the clock to the digital logic inside the analog block

field.name: RTC_XTAL_SOURCE
field.description: This field indicates which chip source is being used for the rtc clock

field.name: XTAL_24M_PWD
field.description: This field powers down the 24M crystal oscillator if set true

field.name: DISCON_HIGH_SNVS
field.description: This bit controls a switch from VDD_HIGH_IN to VDD_SNVS_IN.

field.name: OSC_I
field.description: This field determines the bias current in the 24MHz oscillator

field.name: OSC_XTALOK
field.description: Status bit that signals that the output of the 24-MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: OSC_XTALOK_EN
field.description: This bit enables the detector that signals when the 24MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: CLKGATE_CTRL
field.description: This bit allows disabling the clock gate (always ungated) for the xtal 24MHz clock that clocks the digital logic in the analog block

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOW_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Allow the logic to automatically gate the clock when the XTAL is powered down.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Prevent the logic from ever gating off the clock.

field.name: CLKGATE_DELAY
field.description: This field specifies the delay between powering up the XTAL 24MHz clock and releasing the clock to the digital logic inside the analog block

field.name: RTC_XTAL_SOURCE
field.description: This field indicates which chip source is being used for the rtc clock

field.name: XTAL_24M_PWD
field.description: This field powers down the 24M crystal oscillator if set true

field.name: VID_PLL_PREDIV
field.description: Predivider for the source clock of the PLL's.

field.name: REFTOP_PWD
field.description: Control bit to power-down the analog bandgap reference circuitry

field.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF
field.description: Control bit to disable the self-bias circuit in the analog bandgap

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Uses coarse bias currents for startup

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Uses bandgap-based bias currents for best performance.

field.name: REFTOP_VBGADJ
field.description: Not related to CCM. See Power Management Unit (PMU)

field.name: REFTOP_VBGUP
field.description: Status bit that signals the analog bandgap voltage is up and stable

field.description: Fixed read-only value reflecting the stepping of the RTL version.

field.name: MINOR
field.description: Fixed read-only value reflecting the MINOR field of the RTL version.

field.name: MAJOR
field.description: Fixed read-only value reflecting the MAJOR field of the RTL version.

enumeratedValue.name: ENMOD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Counter starts counting from the value it had when it was disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENMOD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Counter starts count from load value (RLD=1) or 0xFFFF_FFFF (If RLD=0)

enumeratedValue.name: RLD_0
enumeratedValue.description: When the counter reaches zero it rolls over to 0xFFFF_FFFF (free-running mode)

enumeratedValue.name: RLD_1
enumeratedValue.description: When the counter reaches zero it reloads from the modulus register (set-and-forget mode)

enumeratedValue.name: IOVW_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write to load register does not result in counter value being overwritten.

enumeratedValue.name: IOVW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write to load register results in immediate overwriting of counter value.

field.name: DBGEN
field.description: This bit is used to keep the EPIT functional in debug mode

field.name: WAITEN
field.description: This read/write control bit enables the operation of the EPIT during wait mode

enumeratedValue.name: WAITEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: EPIT is disabled in wait mode

enumeratedValue.name: WAITEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: EPIT is enabled in wait mode

enumeratedValue.name: STOPEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: EPIT is disabled in stop mode

enumeratedValue.name: STOPEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: EPIT is enabled in stop mode

field.name: OM
field.description: EPIT output mode.This bit field determines the mode of EPIT output on the output pin.

enumeratedValue.name: OM_0
enumeratedValue.description: EPIT output is disconnected from pad

field.name: CLKSRC
field.description: Select clock source These bits determine which clock input is to be selected for running the counter

field.name: LOAD
field.description: Load value. Value that is loaded into the counter at the start of each count cycle.

field.name: COMPARE
field.description: Compare Value. When the counter value equals this bit field value a compare event is generated.

field.name: COUNT
field.description: Counter value. This contains the current value of the counter.

field.name: warm_rst_bypass_count
field.description: Defines the XTALI cycles to count before bypassing the MMDC acknowledge for WARM reset

enumeratedValue.name: warm_rst_bypass_count_0
enumeratedValue.description: Counter not to be used - system will wait until MMDC acknowledge until it is asserted.

enumeratedValue.name: warm_rst_bypass_count_1
enumeratedValue.description: Wait 16 XTALI cycles before changing WARM reset to a COLD reset.

enumeratedValue.name: warm_rst_bypass_count_2
enumeratedValue.description: Wait 32 XTALI cycles before changing WARM reset to a COLD reset.

enumeratedValue.name: warm_rst_bypass_count_3
enumeratedValue.description: Wait 64 XTALI cycles before changing WARM reset to a COLD reset

field.name: eim_rst
field.description: EIM reset is needed in order to reconfigure the eim chip select

field.name: core0_dbg_rst
field.description: Software reset for core0 debug only

enumeratedValue.name: core0_dbg_rst_0
enumeratedValue.description: do not assert core0 debug reset

field.name: cores_dbg_rst
field.description: Software reset for debug of arm platform only

enumeratedValue.name: cores_dbg_rst_0
enumeratedValue.description: do not assert arm platform debug reset

field.name: dbg_rst_msk_pg
field.description: Do not assert debug resets after power gating event of core

enumeratedValue.name: dbg_rst_msk_pg_0
enumeratedValue.description: do not mask core debug resets (debug resets will be asserted after power gating event)

enumeratedValue.name: dbg_rst_msk_pg_1
enumeratedValue.description: mask core debug resets (debug resets won't be asserted after power gating event)

field.name: mix_rst_strch

enumeratedValue.description: mix reset width is 88 ipg_cycle cycles

enumeratedValue.name: mix_rst_strch_1
enumeratedValue.description: mix reset width is 2 * 88 ipg_cycle cycles

enumeratedValue.name: mix_rst_strch_2
enumeratedValue.description: mix reset width is 3 * 88 ipg_cycle cycles

enumeratedValue.name: mix_rst_strch_3
enumeratedValue.description: mix reset width is 4 * 88 ipg_cycle cycles

field.name: MC0PTR

field.name: HI
field.description: The ARM platform Interrupts register contains the 32 HI[i] bits

field.name: HE
field.description: This 32-bit register gives access to the ARM platform Enable bits

field.name: HSTART_HE
field.description: The HSTART_HE registers are 32 bits wide with one bit for every channel

field.name: EO
field.description: The Channel Event Override register contains the 32 EO[i] bits

field.name: HO
field.description: The Channel ARM platform Override register contains the 32 HO[i] bits

field.name: EP
field.description: The Channel Event Pending register contains the 32 EP[i] bits

field.name: RESET
field.description: When set, this bit causes the SDMA to be held in a software reset

field.name: RESCHED
field.description: When set, this bit forces the SDMA to reschedule as if a script had executed a done instruction

field.name: CHNERR
field.description: This register is used by the SDMA to warn the ARM platform when an incoming DMA request was detected and it triggers a channel that is already pending or being serviced

field.name: HIMASK
field.description: The Interrupt Mask Register contains 32 interrupt generation mask bits

field.name: CCR
field.description: The Current Channel Register indicates the number of the channel that is being executed by the SDMA

field.name: CCP
field.description: The Current Channel Priority indicates the priority of the current active channel

field.name: NCR
field.description: The Next Channel Register indicates the number of the next scheduled pending channel with the highest priority

field.name: NCP
field.description: The Next Channel Priority gives the next pending channel priority

field.name: CHNERR
field.description: This register is the same as EVTERR, except reading it does not clear its contents

field.name: ACR
field.description: ARM platform DMA / SDMA Core Clock Ratio

enumeratedValue.name: ACR_0
enumeratedValue.description: ARM platform DMA interface frequency equals twice core frequency

enumeratedValue.name: ACR_1
enumeratedValue.description: ARM platform DMA interface frequency equals core frequency

field.name: RTDOBS
field.description: Indicates if Real-Time Debug pins are used: They do not toggle by default in order to reduce power consumption

field.name: DSPDMA
field.description: This bit's function is reserved and should be configured as zero.

field.name: LOCK
field.description: The LOCK bit is used to restrict access to update SDMA script memory through ROM channel zero scripts and through the OnCE interface under ARM platform control

field.name: SRESET_LOCK_CLR
field.description: The SRESET_LOCK_CLR bit determine if the LOCK bit is cleared on a software reset triggered by writing to the RESET register

enumeratedValue.name: SRESET_LOCK_CLR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Software Reset does not clear the LOCK bit.

enumeratedValue.name: SRESET_LOCK_CLR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Software Reset clears the LOCK bit.

field.name: ENB
field.description: The OnCE Enable register selects the OnCE control source: When cleared (0), the OnCE registers are accessed through the JTAG interface; when set (1), the OnCE registers may be accessed by the ARM platform through the addresses described, as follows

field.name: DATA
field.description: Data register of the OnCE JTAG controller

field.name: INSTR
field.description: Instruction register of the OnCE JTAG controller

field.name: MST
field.description: This flag is raised when the OnCE is controlled from the ARM platform peripheral interface.

enumeratedValue.name: MST_0
enumeratedValue.description: The JTAG interface controls the OnCE.

enumeratedValue.name: MST_1
enumeratedValue.description: The ARM platform peripheral interface controls the OnCE.

field.name: SWB
field.description: This flag is raised when the SDMA has entered debug mode after a software breakpoint.

field.name: ODR
field.description: This flag is raised when the SDMA has entered debug mode after a OnCE debug request.

field.name: EDR
field.description: This flag is raised when the SDMA has entered debug mode after an external debug request.

field.name: RCV
field.description: After each write access to the real time buffer (RTB), the RCV bit is set

field.name: PST
field.description: The Processor Status bits reflect the state of the SDMA RISC engine

field.name: CMD
field.description: Writing to this register will cause the OnCE to execute the command that is written

field.name: ILLINSTADDR
field.description: The Illegal Instruction Trap Address is the address where the SDMA jumps when an illegal instruction is executed

field.name: CHN0ADDR
field.description: This 14-bit register is used by the boot code of the SDMA

field.name: SMSZ
field.description: The bit 14 (Scratch Memory Size) determines if scratch memory must be available after every channel context

field.name: EVENTS
field.description: This register reflects the DMA requests received by the SDMA for events 31-0

field.name: EVENTS
field.description: This register reflects the DMA requests received by the SDMA for events 47-32

field.name: NUM0
field.description: Contains the number of the DMA request or channel that triggers the pulse on the cross-trigger event line number i

field.name: CNF0
field.description: Configuration of the SDMA event line number i that is connected to the cross-trigger

field.name: NUM1
field.description: Contains the number of the DMA request or channel that triggers the pulse on the cross-trigger event line number i

field.name: CNF1
field.description: Configuration of the SDMA event line number i that is connected to the cross-trigger

field.name: NUM2
field.description: Contains the number of the DMA request or channel that triggers the pulse on the cross-trigger event line number i

field.name: CNF2
field.description: Configuration of the SDMA event line number i that is connected to the cross-trigger

field.name: NUM3
field.description: Contains the number of the DMA request or channel that triggers the pulse on the cross-trigger event line number i

field.name: CNF3
field.description: Configuration of the SDMA event line number i that is connected to the cross-trigger

field.name: NUM4
field.description: Contains the number of the DMA request or channel that triggers the pulse on the cross-trigger event line number i

field.name: CNF4
field.description: Configuration of the SDMA event line number i that is connected to the cross-trigger

field.name: NUM5
field.description: Contains the number of the DMA request or channel that triggers the pulse on the cross-trigger event line number i

field.name: CNF5
field.description: Configuration of the SDMA event line number i that is connected to the cross-trigger

field.name: NUM6
field.description: Contains the number of the DMA request or channel that triggers the pulse on the cross-trigger event line number i

field.name: CNF6
field.description: Configuration of the SDMA event line number i that is connected to the cross-trigger

field.name: NUM7
field.description: Contains the number of the DMA request or channel that triggers the pulse on the cross-trigger event line number i

field.name: CNF7
field.description: Configuration of the SDMA event line number i that is connected to the cross-trigger

field.name: CHNPRIn
field.description: This contains the priority of channel number n

field.name: ENBLn
field.description: This 32-bit value selects the channels that are triggered by the DMA request number n

field.name: REVISION
field.description: Revision number of the controller core.

field.name: PHYW
field.description: Data width of the transciever connected to the controller core. PHYW bit reset value is

enumeratedValue.name: PHYW_0
enumeratedValue.description: 8 bit wide data bus Software non-programmable

enumeratedValue.name: PHYW_1
enumeratedValue.description: 16 bit wide data bus Software non-programmable

enumeratedValue.name: PHYW_2
enumeratedValue.description: Reset to 8 bit wide data bus Software programmable

enumeratedValue.name: PHYW_3
enumeratedValue.description: Reset to 16 bit wide data bus Software programmable

enumeratedValue.name: PHYM_5
enumeratedValue.description: Software programmable - reset to ULPI DDR

enumeratedValue.name: SM_0
enumeratedValue.description: No Serial Engine, always use parallel signalling.

enumeratedValue.name: SM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Serial Engine present, always use serial signalling for FS/LS.

enumeratedValue.name: SM_2
enumeratedValue.description: Software programmable - Reset to use parallel signalling for FS/LS

enumeratedValue.name: SM_3
enumeratedValue.description: Software programmable - Reset to use serial signalling for FS/LS

field.name: HC
field.description: Host Capable. Indicating whether host operation mode is supported or not.

field.name: NPORT
field.description: The Nmber of downstream ports supported by the host controller is (NPORT+1)

field.name: DC
field.description: Device Capable. Indicating whether device operation mode is supported or not.

field.name: TXBURST
field.description: Default burst size for memory to TX buffer transfer

field.name: TXCHANADD
field.description: TX FIFO Buffer size is: (2^TXCHANADD) * 4 Bytes

field.name: RXBURST
field.description: Default burst size for memory to RX buffer transfer

field.name: RXADD
field.description: Buffer total size for all receive endpoints is (2^RXADD)

field.name: GPTLD
field.description: General Purpose Timer Load Value These bit fields are loaded to GPTCNT bits when GPTRST bit is set '1b'

field.name: GPTCNT
field.description: General Purpose Timer Counter. This field is the count value of the countdown timer.

field.name: GPTMODE
field.description: General Purpose Timer Mode In one shot mode, the timer will count down to zero, generate an interrupt, and stop until the counter is reset by software; In repeat mode, the timer will count down to zero, generate an interrupt and automatically reload the counter value from GPTLD bits to start again

enumeratedValue.name: GPTRST_1
enumeratedValue.description: Load counter value from GPTLD bits in n_GPTIMER0LD

field.name: GPTRUN
field.description: General Purpose Timer Run GPTCNT bits are not effected when setting or clearing this bit.

field.name: GPTLD
field.description: General Purpose Timer Load Value These bit fields are loaded to GPTCNT bits when GPTRST bit is set '1b'

field.name: GPTCNT
field.description: General Purpose Timer Counter. This field is the count value of the countdown timer.

field.name: GPTMODE
field.description: General Purpose Timer Mode In one shot mode, the timer will count down to zero, generate an interrupt, and stop until the counter is reset by software

enumeratedValue.name: GPTRST_1
enumeratedValue.description: Load counter value from GPTLD bits in USB_n_GPTIMER0LD

field.name: GPTRUN
field.description: General Purpose Timer Run GPTCNT bits are not effected when setting or clearing this bit.

field.name: AHBBRST
field.description: AHB master interface Burst configuration These bits control AHB master transfer type sequence (or priority)

enumeratedValue.name: AHBBRST_0
enumeratedValue.description: Incremental burst of unspecified length only

enumeratedValue.name: AHBBRST_2
enumeratedValue.description: INCR8 burst, INCR4 burst, then single transfer

enumeratedValue.name: AHBBRST_3
enumeratedValue.description: INCR16 burst, INCR8 burst, INCR4 burst, then single transfer

enumeratedValue.name: AHBBRST_5
enumeratedValue.description: INCR4 burst, then incremental burst of unspecified length

enumeratedValue.name: AHBBRST_6
enumeratedValue.description: INCR8 burst, INCR4 burst, then incremental burst of unspecified length

enumeratedValue.name: AHBBRST_7
enumeratedValue.description: INCR16 burst, INCR8 burst, INCR4 burst, then incremental burst of unspecified length

field.name: CAPLENGTH
field.description: These bits are used as an offset to add to register base to find the beginning of the Operational Register

field.name: HCIVERSION
field.description: Host Controller Interface Version Number Default value is '10h', which means EHCI rev1.0.

field.name: PPC
field.description: Port Power Control This field indicates whether the host controller implementation includes port power control

field.name: N_PCC
field.description: Number of Ports per Companion Controller This field indicates the number of ports supported per internal Companion Controller

enumeratedValue.name: N_CC_0
enumeratedValue.description: There is no internal Companion Controller and port-ownership hand-off is not supported.

enumeratedValue.name: N_CC_1
enumeratedValue.description: There are internal companion controller(s) and port-ownership hand-offs is supported.

field.name: PI
field.description: Port Indicators (P INDICATOR) This bit indicates whether the ports support port indicator control

field.name: N_PTT
field.description: Number of Ports per Transaction Translator (N_PTT)

field.name: ADC
field.description: 64-bit Addressing Capability This bit is set '0b' in all controller core, no 64-bit addressing capability is supported

field.name: PFL
field.description: Programmable Frame List Flag If this bit is set to zero, then the system software must use a frame list length of 1024 elements with this host controller

field.name: ASP
field.description: Asynchronous Schedule Park Capability If this bit is set to a one, then the host controller supports the park feature for high-speed queue heads in the Asynchronous Schedule

field.name: DCIVERSION
field.description: Device Controller Interface Version Number Default value is '01h', which means rev0.1.

field.name: DEN
field.description: Device Endpoint Number This field indicates the number of endpoints built into the device controller

field.name: DC
field.description: Device Capable When this bit is 1, this controller is capable of operating as a USB 2.0 device.

field.name: HC
field.description: Host Capable When this bit is 1, this controller is capable of operating as an EHCI compatible USB 2

enumeratedValue.name: PSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not process the Periodic Schedule

enumeratedValue.name: PSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use the PERIODICLISTBASE register to access the Periodic Schedule.

enumeratedValue.name: ASE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not process the Asynchronous Schedule.

enumeratedValue.name: ASE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use the ASYNCLISTADDR register to access the Asynchronous Schedule.

field.name: IAA
field.description: Interrupt on Async Advance Doorbell - Read/Write

field.name: ASP
field.description: Asynchronous Schedule Park Mode Count - Read/Write

field.name: ASPE
field.description: Asynchronous Schedule Park Mode Enable - Read/Write

field.name: FS_2
field.description: See also bits 3-2 Frame List Size - (Read/Write or Read Only)

field.name: UE
field.description: USB Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the UI bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: UEE
field.description: USB Error Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the UEI bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: PCE
field.description: Port Change Detect Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the PCI bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: FRE
field.description: Frame List Rollover Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the FRI bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: SEE
field.description: System Error Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the SEI bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: AAE
field.description: Async Advance Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the AAI bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: URE
field.description: USB Reset Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the URI bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: SRE
field.description: SOF Received Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the SRI bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: SLE
field.description: Sleep Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the SLI bit in n_n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: ULPIE
field.description: ULPI Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the UPLII bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: NAKE
field.description: NAK Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the NAKI bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: UAIE
field.description: USB Host Asynchronous Interrupt Enable When this bit is one, and the UAI bit in the n_USBSTS register is one, host controller will issue an interrupt at the next interrupt threshold

field.name: UPIE
field.description: USB Host Periodic Interrupt Enable When this bit is one, and the UPI bit in the n_USBSTS register is one, host controller will issue an interrupt at the next interrupt threshold

field.name: TIE0
field.description: General Purpose Timer #0 Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the TI0 bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: TIE1
field.description: General Purpose Timer #1 Interrupt Enable When this bit is one and the TI1 bit in n_USBSTS register is a one the controller will issue an interrupt

field.name: USBADR
field.description: Device Address. These bits correspond to the USB device address

field.name: CF
field.description: Configure Flag Host software sets this bit as the last action in its process of configuring the Host Controller

enumeratedValue.name: CF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Port routing control logic default-routes each port to an implementation dependent classic host controller.

enumeratedValue.name: CF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Port routing control logic default-routes all ports to this host controller.

enumeratedValue.name: OCA_0
enumeratedValue.description: This port does not have an over-current condition.

enumeratedValue.name: OCA_1
enumeratedValue.description: This port currently has an over-current condition

field.name: PR
field.description: Port Reset - Read/Write or Read Only

field.name: PHCD
field.description: PHY Low Power Suspend - Clock Disable (PLPSCD) - Read/Write

field.name: PFSC
field.description: Port Force Full Speed Connect - Read/Write

field.name: PSPD
field.description: Port Speed - Read Only. This register field indicates the speed at which the port is operating.

field.name: PTW
field.description: Parallel Transceiver Width This bit has no effect if serial interface engine is used

field.name: STS
field.description: Serial Transceiver Select 1 Serial Interface Engine is selected 0 Parallel Interface signals is selected Serial Interface Engine can be used in combination with UTMI+/ULPI physical interface to provide FS/LS signaling instead of the parallel interface signals

field.name: PTS_1
field.description: All USB port interface modes are listed in this field description, but not all are supported

field.name: VD
field.description: VBUS_Discharge - Read/Write. Setting this bit causes VBus to discharge through a resistor.

field.name: IDPU
field.description: ID Pullup - Read/Write This bit provide control over the ID pull-up resistor; 0 = off, 1 = on [default]

field.name: ID
field.description: USB ID - Read Only. 0 = A device, 1 = B device

field.name: AVV
field.description: A VBus Valid - Read Only. Indicates VBus is above the A VBus valid threshold.

field.name: ASV
field.description: A Session Valid - Read Only. Indicates VBus is above the A session valid threshold.

field.name: BSV
field.description: B Session Valid - Read Only. Indicates VBus is above the B session valid threshold.

field.name: BSE
field.description: B Session End - Read Only. Indicates VBus is below the B session end threshold.

field.name: TOG_1MS
field.description: 1 millisecond timer toggle - Read Only. This bit toggles once per millisecond.

field.name: DPS
field.description: Data Bus Pulsing Status - Read Only

field.name: AVVIS
field.description: A VBus Valid Interrupt Status - Read/Write to Clear

field.name: ASVIS
field.description: A Session Valid Interrupt Status - Read/Write to Clear

field.name: BSVIS
field.description: B Session Valid Interrupt Status - Read/Write to Clear

field.name: BSEIS
field.description: B Session End Interrupt Status - Read/Write to Clear

field.name: STATUS_1MS
field.description: 1 millisecond timer Interrupt Status - Read/Write to Clear

field.name: DPIS
field.description: Data Pulse Interrupt Status - Read/Write to Clear

field.name: IDIE
field.description: USB ID Interrupt Enable - Read/Write. Setting this bit enables the USB ID interrupt.

field.name: AVVIE
field.description: A VBus Valid Interrupt Enable - Read/Write. Setting this bit enables the A VBus valid interrupt.

field.name: ASVIE
field.description: A Session Valid Interrupt Enable - Read/Write

field.name: BSVIE
field.description: B Session Valid Interrupt Enable - Read/Write

field.name: BSEIE
field.description: B Session End Interrupt Enable - Read/Write. Setting this bit enables the B session end interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: CM_3
enumeratedValue.description: Host Controller [Default for host only controller]

enumeratedValue.name: PADEN_1

enumeratedValue.name: PAUFWD_1

enumeratedValue.name: CFEN_1

enumeratedValue.name: TFC_PAUSE_1

enumeratedValue.name: SHIFT16_1
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates to the transmit data FIFO that the written frames contain two additional octets before the frame data. This means the actual frame begins at bit 16 of the first word written into the FIFO. This function allows putting the frame payload on a 32-bit boundary in memory, as the 14-byte Ethernet header is extended to a 16-byte header.

field.name: IPCHK
field.description: Enables insertion of IP header checksum.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCHK_1
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically. The IP header checksum field must be cleared. If a non-IP frame is transmitted the frame is not modified.

enumeratedValue.name: PROCHK_1
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame with a known protocol is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically into the frame. The checksum field must be cleared. The other frames are not modified.

field.name: PADREM
field.description: Enable Padding Removal For Short IP Frames

enumeratedValue.name: PADREM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Any bytes following the IP payload section of the frame are removed from the frame.

field.name: IPDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong IPv4 Header Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: IPDIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong IPv4 header checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: IPDIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: If an IPv4 frame is received with a mismatching header checksum, the frame is discarded. IPv6 has no header checksum and is not affected by this setting. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: PRODIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong Protocol Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: PRODIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: PRODIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: If a TCP/IP, UDP/IP, or ICMP/IP frame is received that has a wrong TCP, UDP, or ICMP checksum, the frame is discarded. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: LINEDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With MAC Layer Errors

enumeratedValue.name: LINEDIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with errors are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: LINEDIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Any frame received with a CRC, length, or PHY error is automatically discarded and not forwarded to the user application interface.

enumeratedValue.name: SHIFT16_1
enumeratedValue.description: Instructs the MAC to write two additional bytes in front of each frame received into the RX FIFO.
