enumeratedValue.name: EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The timer stops at the current value.

enumeratedValue.name: OFFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The timer can be reset to zero when the given offset time is reached (offset event). The field is cleared when the offset event is reached, so no further event occurs until the field is set again. The timer offset value must be set before setting this field.

enumeratedValue.name: OFFRST_0
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is not affected and no action occurs, besides clearing OFFEN, when the offset is reached.

enumeratedValue.name: OFFRST_1
enumeratedValue.description: If OFFEN is set, the timer resets to zero when the offset setting is reached. The offset event does not cause a timer interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: PEREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: A period event interrupt can be generated (EIR[TS_TIMER]) and the event signal output is asserted when the timer wraps around according to the periodic setting ATPER. The timer period value must be set before setting this bit. Not all devices contain the event signal output. See the chip configuration details.

field.name: PINPER
field.description: Enables event signal output assertion on period event

enumeratedValue.name: CAPTURE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The current time is captured and can be read from the ATVR register.

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is active and all configuration fields in this register are relevant.

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The internal timer is disabled and the externally provided timer value is used. All other fields, except CAPTURE, in this register have no effect. CAPTURE can still be used to capture the current timer value.

field.name: MTX
field.description: Transmit/Receive mode select bit. Selects the direction of master and slave transfers.

enumeratedValue.name: MTX_0
enumeratedValue.description: Receive.When a slave is addressed, the software should set MTX according to the slave read/write bit in the I2C status register (I2C_I2SR[SRW]).

enumeratedValue.name: MTX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit.In Master mode, MTX should be set according to the type of transfer required. Therefore, for address cycles, MTX is always 1.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Slave mode. Changing MSTA from 1 to 0 generates a Stop and selects Slave mode.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Master mode. Changing MSTA from 0 to 1 signals a Start on the bus and selects Master mode.

enumeratedValue.name: IIEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: I2C interrupts are disabled, but the status flag I2C_I2SR[IIF] continues to be set when an Interrupt condition occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: IIEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: I2C interrupts are enabled. An I2C interrupt occurs if I2C_I2SR[IIF] is also set.

enumeratedValue.name: IEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The block is disabled, but registers can still be accessed.

enumeratedValue.name: IEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The I2C is enabled. This bit must be set before any other I2C_I2CR bits have an effect.

enumeratedValue.name: RXAK_0
enumeratedValue.description: An "acknowledge" signal was received after the completion of an 8-bit data transmission on the bus.

enumeratedValue.name: RXAK_1
enumeratedValue.description: A "No acknowledge" signal was detected at the ninth clock.

enumeratedValue.name: IIF_1
enumeratedValue.description: An interrupt is pending.This causes a processor interrupt request (if the interrupt enable is asserted [IIEN = 1]). The interrupt is set when one of the following occurs: One byte transfer is completed (the interrupt is set at the falling edge of the ninth clock). An address is received that matches its own specific address in Slave Receive mode. Arbitration is lost.

enumeratedValue.name: SRW_0
enumeratedValue.description: Slave receive, master writing to slave

enumeratedValue.name: SRW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Slave transmit, master reading from slave

enumeratedValue.name: IBB_0
enumeratedValue.description: Bus is idle. If a Stop signal is detected, IBB is cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: IBB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bus is busy. When Start is detected, IBB is set.

field.name: IAAS
field.description: I2C addressed as a slave bit

enumeratedValue.name: IAAS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Addressed as a slave. Set when its own address (I2C_IADR) matches the calling address.

field.name: ICF
field.description: Data transferring bit. While one byte of data is transferred, ICF is cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: ICF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transfer is complete. This bit is set by the falling edge of the ninth clock of the last byte transfer.

enumeratedValue.name: ARCR_EXC_ERR_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: violation of AXI exclusive rules (6.2.4) result in SLAVE Error response (rresp/bresp=2'b10)

field.name: ARCR_SEC_ERR_EN

enumeratedValue.name: ARCR_SEC_ERR_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: security violation results in OKAY response (rresp/bresp=2'b00)

enumeratedValue.name: ARCR_SEC_ERR_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: security violation results in SLAVE Error response (rresp/bresp=2'b10)

enumeratedValue.name: ARCR_SEC_ERR_LOCK_1

register.name: CS%sGCR1
register.description: Chip Select n General Configuration Register 1

enumeratedValue.name: CSEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Chip select function is disabled; attempts to access an address mapped by this chip select results in an error respond and no assertion of the chip select output

enumeratedValue.name: CSEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Chip select is enabled, and is asserted when presented with a valid access.

enumeratedValue.name: SWR_0
enumeratedValue.description: write accesses are in Asynchronous mode

enumeratedValue.name: SWR_1
enumeratedValue.description: write accesses are in Synchronous mode

enumeratedValue.name: SRD_0
enumeratedValue.description: read accesses are in Asynchronous mode

enumeratedValue.name: SRD_1
enumeratedValue.description: read accesses are in Synchronous mode

enumeratedValue.name: WFL_0
enumeratedValue.description: the External device WAIT signal is being monitored, and it reflect the external data bus state

enumeratedValue.name: WFL_1
enumeratedValue.description: the state of the External devices is determined internally (Fix latency mode only)

enumeratedValue.name: RFL_0
enumeratedValue.description: the External device WAIT signal is being monitored, and it reflect the external data bus state

enumeratedValue.name: RFL_1
enumeratedValue.description: the state of the External devices is determined internally (Fix latency mode only)

enumeratedValue.name: BL_0
enumeratedValue.description: 4 words Memory wrap burst length (read page burst size when APR = 1)

enumeratedValue.name: BL_1
enumeratedValue.description: 8 words Memory wrap burst length (read page burst size when APR = 1)

enumeratedValue.name: BL_2
enumeratedValue.description: 16 words Memory wrap burst length (read page burst size when APR = 1)

enumeratedValue.name: BL_3
enumeratedValue.description: 32 words Memory wrap burst length (read page burst size when APR = 1)

enumeratedValue.name: BL_4
enumeratedValue.description: Continuous burst length (2 words read page burst size when APR = 1)

enumeratedValue.name: WC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write access burst length occurs according to BL value.

enumeratedValue.name: WC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write access burst length is continuous.

enumeratedValue.name: SP_0
enumeratedValue.description: User mode accesses are allowed in the memory range defined by chip select.

enumeratedValue.name: SP_1
enumeratedValue.description: User mode accesses are prohibited. All attempts to access an address mapped by this chip select in User mode results in an error response and no assertion of the chip select output.

enumeratedValue.name: CSREC_0
enumeratedValue.description: 0 EIM clock cycles minimum width of CS, OE and WE signals (read async. mode only)

enumeratedValue.name: CSREC_1
enumeratedValue.description: 1 EIM clock cycles minimum width of CS, OE and WE signals

enumeratedValue.name: CSREC_2
enumeratedValue.description: 2 EIM clock cycles minimum width of CS, OE and WE signals

enumeratedValue.name: CSREC_7
enumeratedValue.description: 7 EIM clock cycles minimum width of CS, OE and WE signals

enumeratedValue.name: AUS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Address shifted according to port size (DSZ config) (128 Mbyte maximum supported memory density).

enumeratedValue.name: AUS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Address unshifted (32 Mbyte maximum supported memory density).

enumeratedValue.name: GBC_0
enumeratedValue.description: minimum of 0 EIM clock cycles before next access from different chip select (async. mode only)

enumeratedValue.name: GBC_1
enumeratedValue.description: minimum of 1 EIM clock cycles before next access from different chip select

enumeratedValue.name: GBC_2
enumeratedValue.description: minimum of 2 EIM clock cycles before next access from different chip select

enumeratedValue.name: GBC_7
enumeratedValue.description: minimum of 7 EIM clock cycles before next access from different chip select

enumeratedValue.name: WP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed in the memory range defined by chip.

enumeratedValue.name: WP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited. All attempts to write to an address mapped by this chip select result in a error response and no assertion of the chip select output.

enumeratedValue.name: REDGE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Pixel data is latched at the falling edge of CSI_PIXCLK

enumeratedValue.name: REDGE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Pixel data is latched at the rising edge of CSI_PIXCLK

enumeratedValue.name: INV_PCLK_0
enumeratedValue.description: CSI_PIXCLK is directly applied to internal circuitry

enumeratedValue.name: INV_PCLK_1
enumeratedValue.description: CSI_PIXCLK is inverted before applied to internal circuitry

field.name: INV_DATA
field.description: Invert Data Input. This bit enables or disables internal inverters on the data lines.

enumeratedValue.name: INV_DATA_0
enumeratedValue.description: CSI_D[7:0] data lines are directly applied to internal circuitry

enumeratedValue.name: INV_DATA_1
enumeratedValue.description: CSI_D[7:0] data lines are inverted before applied to internal circuitry

enumeratedValue.name: GCLK_MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Non-gated clock mode. All incoming pixel clocks are valid. HSYNC is ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: GCLK_MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Gated clock mode. Pixel clock signal is valid only when HSYNC is active.

enumeratedValue.name: PACK_DIR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Pack from LSB first. For image data, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33, 0x44, it will appear as 0x44332211 in RX FIFO. For stat data, 0xAAAA, 0xBBBB, it will appear as 0xBBBBAAAA in STAT FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: PACK_DIR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Pack from MSB first. For image data, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33, 0x44, it will appear as 0x11223344 in RX FIFO. For stat data, 0xAAAA, 0xBBBB, it will appear as 0xAAAABBBB in STAT FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: CCIR_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Traditional interface is selected. Timing interface logic is used to latch data.

field.name: SOF_INTEN
field.description: Start Of Frame (SOF) Interrupt Enable. This bit enables the SOF interrupt.

field.name: SOF_POL
field.description: SOF Interrupt Polarity. This bit controls the condition that generates an SOF interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: SOF_POL_0
enumeratedValue.description: SOF interrupt is generated on SOF falling edge

enumeratedValue.name: SOF_POL_1
enumeratedValue.description: SOF interrupt is generated on SOF rising edge

field.name: RXFF_INTEN
field.description: RxFIFO Full Interrupt Enable. This bit enables the RxFIFO full interrupt.

field.name: FB1_DMA_DONE_INTEN
field.description: Frame Buffer1 DMA Transfer Done Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: FB1_DMA_DONE_INTEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frame Buffer1 DMA Transfer Done interrupt disable

enumeratedValue.name: FB1_DMA_DONE_INTEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Frame Buffer1 DMA Transfer Done interrupt enable

field.name: FB2_DMA_DONE_INTEN
field.description: Frame Buffer2 DMA Transfer Done Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: FB2_DMA_DONE_INTEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frame Buffer2 DMA Transfer Done interrupt disable

enumeratedValue.name: FB2_DMA_DONE_INTEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Frame Buffer2 DMA Transfer Done interrupt enable

field.name: STATFF_INTEN
field.description: STATFIFO Full Interrupt Enable. This bit enables the STAT FIFO interrupt.

field.name: SFF_DMA_DONE_INTEN
field.description: STATFIFO DMA Transfer Done Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: SFF_DMA_DONE_INTEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: STATFIFO DMA Transfer Done interrupt disable

enumeratedValue.name: SFF_DMA_DONE_INTEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: STATFIFO DMA Transfer Done interrupt enable

field.name: RF_OR_INTEN
field.description: RxFIFO Overrun Interrupt Enable. This bit enables the RX FIFO overrun interrupt.

field.name: SF_OR_INTEN
field.description: STAT FIFO Overrun Interrupt Enable. This bit enables the STATFIFO overrun interrupt.

field.name: COF_INT_EN
field.description: Change Of Image Field (COF) Interrupt Enable

field.name: VIDEO_MODE
field.description: Video mode select. This bit controls the video mode in CCIR mode and TV decoder input.

enumeratedValue.name: PrP_IF_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: CSI to PrP bus is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: PrP_IF_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: CSI to PrP bus is enabled

field.name: EOF_INT_EN
field.description: End-of-Frame Interrupt Enable. This bit enables and disables the EOF interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: EOF_INT_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: EOF interrupt is generated when RX count value is reached.

field.name: VSC
field.description: Vertical Skip Count. Contains the number of rows to skip. SCE must be 1, otherwise VSC is ignored.

field.name: LVRM
field.description: Live View Resolution Mode. Selects the grid size used for live view resolution.

field.name: BTS
field.description: Bayer Tile Start. Controls the Bayer pattern starting point.

field.name: SCE
field.description: Skip Count Enable. Enables or disables the skip count feature.

field.name: AFS
field.description: Auto Focus Spread. Selects which green pixels are used for auto-focus.

enumeratedValue.name: AFS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Abs Diff on consecutive green pixels

enumeratedValue.name: AFS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Abs Diff on every third green pixels

field.name: DRM
field.description: Double Resolution Mode. Controls size of statistics grid.

field.name: DMA_BURST_TYPE_SFF
field.description: Burst Type of DMA Transfer from STATFIFO. Selects the burst type of DMA transfer from STATFIFO.

field.name: DMA_BURST_TYPE_RFF
field.description: Burst Type of DMA Transfer from RxFIFO. Selects the burst type of DMA transfer from RxFIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ECC_INT_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt is generated when error is detected. Only the status bit ECC_INT is set.

enumeratedValue.name: ECC_INT_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt is generated when error is detected.

enumeratedValue.name: TWO_8BIT_SENSOR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Two 8-bit sensors are connected or one 16-bit sensor is connected.

field.name: HRESP_ERR_EN
field.description: Hresponse Error Enable. This bit enables the hresponse error interrupt.

field.name: FRMCNT_RST
field.description: Frame Count Reset. Resets the Frame Counter. (Cleared automatically after reset is done)

enumeratedValue.name: DRDY_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least 1 datum (word) is ready in RXFIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ECC_INT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Error is detected in CCIR coding

enumeratedValue.name: COF_INT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Change of video field is detected.

enumeratedValue.name: F1_INT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Field 1 of video is not detected.

enumeratedValue.name: F1_INT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Field 1 of video is about to start.

enumeratedValue.name: F2_INT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Field 2 of video is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: F2_INT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Field 2 of video is about to start

field.name: SOF_INT
field.description: Start of Frame Interrupt Status. Indicates when SOF is detected. (Cleared by writing 1)

field.name: EOF_INT
field.description: End of Frame (EOF) Interrupt Status. Indicates when EOF is detected. (Cleared by writing 1)

field.name: DMA_TSF_DONE_FB1
field.description: DMA Transfer Done in Frame Buffer1

field.name: DMA_TSF_DONE_FB2
field.description: DMA Transfer Done in Frame Buffer2

field.name: DMA_FIELD1_DONE
field.description: When DMA field 0 is complete, this bit will be set to 1(clear by writing 1).

field.name: DMA_FIELD0_DONE
field.description: When DMA field 0 is complete, this bit will be set to 1(clear by writing 1).

field.name: BASEADDR_CHHANGE_ERROR
field.description: When using base address switching enable, this bit will be 1 when switching occur before DMA complete

register.name: CSIDMASA_STATFIFO
register.description: CSI DMA Start Address Register - for STATFIFO

register.name: CSIDMATS_STATFIFO
register.description: CSI DMA Transfer Size Register - for STATFIFO

register.name: CSIDMASA_FB1
register.description: CSI DMA Start Address Register - for Frame Buffer1

field.name: DMA_START_ADDR_FB1
field.description: DMA Start Address in Frame Buffer1

register.name: CSIDMASA_FB2
register.description: CSI DMA Transfer Size Register - for Frame Buffer2

field.name: DMA_START_ADDR_FB2
field.description: DMA Start Address in Frame Buffer2

field.name: DEINTERLACE_STRIDE
field.description: DEINTERLACE_STRIDE is only used in the deinterlace mode

field.name: IMAGE_HEIGHT
field.description: Image Height. Indicates how many pixels in a column of the image from the sensor.

field.name: DEINTERLACE_EN
field.description: This bit is used to select the output method When input is standard CCIR656 video.

field.name: PARALLEL24_EN
field.description: When input is parallel rgb888/yuv444 24bit, this bit can be enabled.

field.name: BASEADDR_SWITCH_EN
field.description: When this bit is enabled, CSI DMA will switch the base address according to BASEADDR_SWITCH_SEL rather than atomically by DMA completed

field.name: BASEADDR_SWITCH_SEL
field.description: CSI 2 base addresses switching method. When using this bit, BASEADDR_SWITCH_EN is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: BASEADDR_SWITCH_SEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Switching base address at the edge of the vsync

enumeratedValue.name: BASEADDR_SWITCH_SEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Switching base address at the edge of the first data of each frame

field.name: FIELD0_DONE_IE
field.description: In interlace mode, fileld 0 means interrupt enabled.

field.name: DMA_FIELD1_DONE_IE
field.description: When in interlace mode, field 1 done interrupt enable.

field.name: LAST_DMA_REQ_SEL
field.description: Choosing the last DMA request condition.

field.name: BASEADDR_CHANGE_ERROR_IE
field.description: Base address change error interrupt enable signal.

field.name: AHB_HPROT
field.description: Hprot value in AHB bus protocol.

field.name: CSI_LCDIF_BUFFER_LINES
field.description: The number of lines are used in handshake mode with LCDIF.

field.name: MASK_OPTION
field.description: These bits used to choose the method to mask the CSI input.

enumeratedValue.name: MASK_OPTION_0
enumeratedValue.description: Writing to memory from first completely frame, when using this option, the CSI_ENABLE should be 1.

enumeratedValue.name: MASK_OPTION_1
enumeratedValue.description: Writing to memory when CSI_ENABLE is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: MASK_OPTION_2
enumeratedValue.description: Writing to memory from second completely frame, when using this option, the CSI_ENABLE should be 1.

enumeratedValue.name: MASK_OPTION_3
enumeratedValue.description: Writing to memory when data comes in, not matter the CSI_ENABLE is 1 or 0.

field.name: DMA_RFIFO_HIGHEST_FIFO_LEVEL
field.description: This byte stores the highest FIFO level achieved by CSI FIFO timely and will be clear by writing 8'ff to it

field.name: RUN
field.description: When this bit is set by software, the eLCDIF will begin transferring data between the SoC and the display

enumeratedValue.name: ALL_24_BITS_VALID
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is in 24 bpp format, such that all RGB 888 data is contained in 24 bits.

enumeratedValue.name: DROP_UPPER_2_BITS_PER_BYTE
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is actually RGB 18 bpp, but there is 1 color per byte, hence the upper 2 bits in each byte do not contain any useful data, and should be dropped.

enumeratedValue.name: LOWER_18_BITS_VALID
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that lower 18 bits contain RGB 666 and upper 14 bits do not contain any useful data.

enumeratedValue.name: UPPER_18_BITS_VALID
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that upper 18 bits contain RGB 666 and lower 14 bits do not contain any useful data.

field.name: DATA_FORMAT_16_BIT
field.description: When this bit is 1 and WORD_LENGTH = 0, it implies that the 16-bit data is in ARGB555 format

field.name: MASTER
field.description: Set this bit to make the eLCDIF act as a bus master.

field.name: ENABLE_PXP_HANDSHAKE
field.description: If this bit is set and LCDIF_MASTER bit is set, the eLCDIF will act as bus master and the handshake mechanism between eLCDIF and PXP will be turned on

field.name: RGB_TO_YCBCR422_CSC
field.description: Set this bit to 1 to enable conversion from RGB to YCbCr colorspace

enumeratedValue.name: 16_BIT
enumeratedValue.description: Input data is 16 bits per pixel.

enumeratedValue.name: 18_BIT
enumeratedValue.description: Input data is 18 bits per pixel.

enumeratedValue.name: 24_BIT
enumeratedValue.description: Input data is 24 bits per pixel.

field.name: CSC_DATA_SWIZZLE
field.description: This field specifies how to swap the bytes after the data has been converted into an internal representation of 24 bits per pixel and before it is transmitted over the LCD interface bus

field.name: INPUT_DATA_SWIZZLE
field.description: This field specifies how to swap the bytes fetched by the bus master interface

field.name: DATA_SELECT
field.description: Command Mode polarity bit. This bit should only be changed when RUN is 0.

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Command Mode. LCD_RS signal is Low.

enumeratedValue.name: DATA_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Data Mode. LCD_RS signal is High.

field.name: DOTCLK_MODE
field.description: Set this bit to 1 to make the hardware go into the DOTCLK mode, i

field.name: VSYNC_MODE
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the eLCDIF hardware go into VSYNC mode

field.name: BYPASS_COUNT
field.description: When this bit is 0, it means that eLCDIF will stop the block operation and turn off the RUN bit after the amount of data indicated by the LCDIF_TRANSFER_COUNT register has been transferred out

field.name: DVI_MODE
field.description: Set this bit to 1 to get into the ITU-R BT

field.name: SHIFT_NUM_BITS
field.description: The data to be transmitted is shifted left or right by this number of bits.

field.name: DATA_SHIFT_DIR
field.description: Use this bit to determine the direction of shift of transmit data

enumeratedValue.name: TXDATA_SHIFT_LEFT
enumeratedValue.description: Data to be transmitted is shifted LEFT by SHIFT_NUM_BITS bits.

enumeratedValue.name: TXDATA_SHIFT_RIGHT
enumeratedValue.description: Data to be transmitted is shifted RIGHT by SHIFT_NUM_BITS bits.

field.name: WAIT_FOR_VSYNC_EDGE
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the hardware wait for the triggering VSYNC edge before starting write transfers to the LCD

field.name: READ_WRITEB
field.description: By default, eLCDIF is in the write mode

field.name: YCBCR422_INPUT
field.description: Zero implies input data is in RGB color space

field.name: CLKGATE
field.description: This bit must be set to zero for normal operation

field.name: SFTRST
field.description: This bit must be set to zero to enable normal operation of the eLCDIF

field.name: RUN
field.description: When this bit is set by software, the eLCDIF will begin transferring data between the SoC and the display

enumeratedValue.name: ALL_24_BITS_VALID
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is in 24 bpp format, such that all RGB 888 data is contained in 24 bits.

enumeratedValue.name: DROP_UPPER_2_BITS_PER_BYTE
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is actually RGB 18 bpp, but there is 1 color per byte, hence the upper 2 bits in each byte do not contain any useful data, and should be dropped.

enumeratedValue.name: LOWER_18_BITS_VALID
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that lower 18 bits contain RGB 666 and upper 14 bits do not contain any useful data.

enumeratedValue.name: UPPER_18_BITS_VALID
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that upper 18 bits contain RGB 666 and lower 14 bits do not contain any useful data.

field.name: DATA_FORMAT_16_BIT
field.description: When this bit is 1 and WORD_LENGTH = 0, it implies that the 16-bit data is in ARGB555 format

field.name: MASTER
field.description: Set this bit to make the eLCDIF act as a bus master.

field.name: ENABLE_PXP_HANDSHAKE
field.description: If this bit is set and LCDIF_MASTER bit is set, the eLCDIF will act as bus master and the handshake mechanism between eLCDIF and PXP will be turned on

field.name: RGB_TO_YCBCR422_CSC
field.description: Set this bit to 1 to enable conversion from RGB to YCbCr colorspace

field.name: MODE86
field.description: This bit is used to select between the 8080 and 6800 series of microprocessor modes

enumeratedValue.name: 8080_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Pins LCD_WR_RWn and LCD_RD_E function as active low WR and active low RD signals respectively.

enumeratedValue.name: 6800_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Pins LCD_WR_RWn and LCD_RD_E function as Read/Write and active high Enable signals respectively.

field.name: BUSY_ENABLE
field.description: This bit enables the use of the interface's busy signal input

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY_DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The busy signal from the LCD controller will be ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY_ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enable the use of the busy signal from the LCD controller.

field.name: VSYNC_EDGE_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the eLCDIF block

field.name: CUR_FRAME_DONE_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the eLCDIF block

field.name: UNDERFLOW_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the eLCDIF block

field.name: OVERFLOW_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the eLCDIF block

field.name: VSYNC_EDGE_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an interrupt every time the hardware encounters the leading VSYNC edge in the VSYNC and DOTCLK modes, or the beginning of every field in DVI mode

field.name: CUR_FRAME_DONE_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to 1 enable an interrupt every time the hardware enters in the vertical blanking state

field.name: UNDERFLOW_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an underflow interrupt in the TXFIFO in the write mode.

field.name: OVERFLOW_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an overflow interrupt in the TXFIFO in the write mode.

field.name: BYTE_PACKING_FORMAT
field.description: This bitfield is used to show which data bytes in a 32-bit word are valid

field.name: IRQ_ON_ALTERNATE_FIELDS
field.description: If this bit is set, the eLCDIF block will assert the cur_frame_done interrupt only on alternate fields, otherwise it will issue the interrupt on both odd and even field

field.name: FIFO_CLEAR
field.description: Set this bit to clear all the data in the latency FIFO (LFIFO), TXFIFO and the RXFIFO.

field.name: START_INTERLACE_FROM_SECOND_FIELD
field.description: The default is to grab the odd lines first and then the even lines

field.name: INTERLACE_FIELDS
field.description: Set this bit if it is required that the eLCDIF block fetches odd lines in one field and even lines in the other field

field.name: RECOVER_ON_UNDERFLOW
field.description: Set this bit to enable the eLCDIF block to recover in the next field/frame if there was an underflow in the current field/frame

field.name: BM_ERROR_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the eLCDIF block

field.name: BM_ERROR_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable bus master error interrupt in the eLCDIF master mode.

field.name: COMBINE_MPU_WR_STRB
field.description: If this bit is not set, the write strobe will be driven on LCD_WR_RWn pin in the 8080 mode and on the LCD_RD_E pin in the 6800 mode

field.name: RESET
field.description: Reset bit for the external LCD controller

field.name: MODE86
field.description: This bit is used to select between the 8080 and 6800 series of microprocessor modes

field.name: VERTICAL_WAIT_CNT

field.name: HORIZONTAL_WAIT_CNT
field.description: In the DOTCLK mode, wait for this number of clocks from falling edge (or rising if HSYNC_POL is 1) of HSYNC signal to account for horizontal back porch plus the number of DOTCLKs before the moving picture information begins

field.name: VSYNC_ONLY
field.description: This bit must be set to 1 in the VSYNC mode of operation, and 0 in the DOTCLK mode of operation.

field.name: MUX_SYNC_SIGNALS
field.description: When this bit is set, the eLCDIF block will internally mux HSYNC with LCD_D14, DOTCLK with LCD_D13 and ENABLE with LCD_D12, otherwise these signals will go out on separate pins

field.name: DOTCLK_DLY_SEL

register.name: CSC_COEFF0
register.description: RGB to YCbCr 4:2:2 CSC Coefficient0 Register

field.name: CSC_SUBSAMPLE_FILTER
field.description: This register describes the filtering and subsampling scheme to be performed on the chroma components in order to convert from YCbCr 4:4:4 to YCbCr 4:2:2 space

enumeratedValue.name: SAMPLE_AND_HOLD
enumeratedValue.description: No filtering, simply keep every chroma value for samples numbered 2n and discard chroma values associated with all samples numbered 2n+1.

enumeratedValue.name: INTERSTITIAL
enumeratedValue.description: Chroma samples numbered 2n and 2n+1 are averaged (weights 1/2, 1/2) and that chroma value replaces the two chroma values at 2n and 2n+1. This chroma now exists horizontally halfway between the two luma samples.

enumeratedValue.name: COSITED
enumeratedValue.description: Chroma samples numbered 2n-1, 2n, and 2n+1 are averaged (weights 1/4, 1/2, 1/4) and that chroma value exists at the same site as the luma sample numbered 2n and the chroma samples at 2n+1 are discarded.

field.name: SWRSTSD
field.description: Software reset for Serial Flash domainPlease keep other fields value when write to SWRSTHD and SWRSTSD These software reset don't reset register setting but only reset internal flip-flops in quadspi controller To remove the reset, need to write 0 to SWRSTHD and SWRSTSD

enumeratedValue.name: SWRSTSD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Serial Flash domain flops are reset. Does not reset configuration registers. It is advisable to reset both the serial flash domain and AHB domain at the same time. Resetting only one domain might lead to side effects.

field.name: SWRSTHD
field.description: Software reset for AHB domainPlease keep other fields value when write to SWRSTHD and SWRSTSD These software reset don't reset register setting but only reset internal flip-flops in quadspi controller To remove the reset, need to write 0 to SWRSTHD and SWRSTSD

enumeratedValue.name: SWRSTHD_1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB domain flops are reset. Does not reset configuration registers. It is advisable to reset both the serial flash domain and AHB domain at the same time. Resetting only one domain might lead to side effects.

enumeratedValue.name: DQS_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: DQS enabled- When enabled, the incoming data is sampled on both the edges of DQS input when QSPI_MCR[DDR_EN] is set, else, on only one edge when QSPI_MCR[DDR_EN] is 0. The QSPI_SMPR[DDR_SMP] values are ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: DDR_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: 2x and 4x clocks are disabled for SDR instructions only

enumeratedValue.name: DDR_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: 2x and 4x clocks are enabled supports both SDR and DDR instruction.

field.name: CLR_TXF

enumeratedValue.name: CLR_TXF_1

field.name: ADATSZ
field.description: AHB data transfer size: Defines the data transfer size in 8 Bytes of an AHB triggered access to serial flash

field.name: ALLMST
field.description: All master enable: When set, buffer3 acts as an all-master buffer

field.name: SEQID
field.description: Points to a sequence in the Look-up-table

field.name: PAR_EN
field.description: When set, a transaction to two serial flash devices is triggered in parallel mode

field.name: SFADR
field.description: Serial Flash Address. The register content is used as byte address for all following IP Commands.

field.name: RDBFL
field.description: RX Buffer Fill Level, indicates how many entries of 4 bytes are still available in the RX Buffer

field.name: RDCTR
field.description: Read Counter, indicates how many entries of 4 bytes have been removed from the RX Buffer

field.name: WMRK
field.description: RX Buffer Watermark: This field determines when the readout action of the RX Buffer is triggered

field.name: RXBRD
field.description: RX Buffer Readout: This bit specifies the access scheme for the RX Buffer readout.

enumeratedValue.name: RXBRD_0
enumeratedValue.description: RX Buffer content is read using the AHB Bus registers QSPI_ARDB0 to QSPI_ARDB31. For details, refer to Exclusive Access to Serial Flash for AHB Commands.

enumeratedValue.name: RXBRD_1
enumeratedValue.description: RX Buffer content is read using the IP Bus registers QSPI_RBDR0 to QSPI_RBDR31.

field.name: TXDATA
field.description: TX Data On write access the data is written into the next available entry of the TX Buffer and the QPSI_TBSR[TRBFL] field is updated accordingly

field.name: BUSY
field.description: Module Busy: Asserted when module is currently busy handling a transaction to an external flash device

field.name: IP_ACC
field.description: IP Access: Asserted when transaction currently executed was initiated by IP bus.

field.name: AHB_ACC
field.description: AHB Access: Asserted when the transaction currently executed was initiated by AHB bus.

field.name: AHBGNT
field.description: AHB Command priority Granted: Asserted when another module has been granted priority of AHB Commands against IP Commands

field.name: AHBTRN
field.description: AHB Access Transaction pending: Asserted when there is a pending request on the AHB interface

field.name: AHB0NE
field.description: AHB 0 Buffer Not Empty: Asserted when AHB 0 buffer contains data.

field.name: AHB1NE
field.description: AHB 1 Buffer Not Empty: Asserted when AHB 1 buffer contains data.

field.name: AHB2NE
field.description: AHB 2 Buffer Not Empty: Asserted when AHB 2 buffer contains data.

field.name: AHB3NE
field.description: AHB 3 Buffer Not Empty: Asserted when AHB 3 buffer contains data.

field.name: AHB0FUL
field.description: AHB 0 Buffer Full: Asserted when AHB 0 buffer is full.

field.name: AHB1FUL
field.description: AHB 1 Buffer Full: Asserted when AHB 1 buffer is full.

field.name: AHB2FUL
field.description: AHB 2 Buffer Full: Asserted when AHB 2 buffer is full.

field.name: AHB3FUL
field.description: AHB 3 Buffer Full: Asserted when AHB 3 buffer is full.

field.name: RXWE
field.description: RX Buffer Watermark Exceeded: Asserted when the number of valid entries in the RX Buffer exceeds the number given in the QSPI_RBCT[WMRK] field

field.name: RXFULL
field.description: RX Buffer Full: Asserted when the RX Buffer is full, i

field.name: RXDMA
field.description: RX Buffer DMA: Asserted when RX Buffer read out via DMA is active i.e DMA is requested or running.

field.name: TXFULL
field.description: TX Buffer Full: Asserted when no more data can be stored.

field.name: DLPSMP
field.description: Data learning is not implemented on this chip

field.name: TFF
field.description: IP Command Transaction Finished Flag: Set when the QuadSPI module has finished a running IP Command

field.name: IPGEF
field.description: IP Command Trigger during AHB Grant Error Flag: Set when the following condition occurs: A write access occurs to the QSPI_IPCR[SEQID] field and the QSPI_SR[AHBGNT] bit is set

field.name: IPIEF
field.description: IP Command Trigger could not be executed Error Flag

field.name: IPAEF
field.description: IP Command Trigger during AHB Access Error Flag

field.name: IUEF
field.description: IP Command Usage Error Flag: Set when in parallel flash mode the execution of an IP Command is started and the sequence pointed to by the sequence ID contains a WRITE or a WRITE_DDR command

field.name: ABOF
field.description: AHB Buffer Overflow Flag: Set when the size of the AHB access exceeds the size of the AHB buffer

field.name: ABSEF
field.description: AHB Sequence Error Flag: Set when the execution of an AHB Command is started with an WRITE or WRITE_DDR Command in the sequence pointed to by the QSPI_BUFxCR QSPI_BUFxCR implies anyone of QSPI_BUF0CR/QSPI_BUF1CR/QSPI_BUF2CR/QSPI_BUF3CR register Communication with the serial flash device is terminated before the execution of WRITE/WRITE_DDR command by the QuadSPI module

field.name: RBDF
field.description: RX Buffer Drain Flag: Will be set if the QuadSPI_SR[RXWE] status bit is asserted

field.name: RBOF
field.description: RX Buffer Overflow Flag: Set when not all the data read from the serial flash device could be pushed into the RX Buffer

field.name: ILLINE
field.description: Illegal Instruction Error Flag: Set when an illegal instruction is encountered by the controller in any of the sequences

field.name: TBUF
field.description: TX Buffer Underrun Flag: Set when the module tried to pull data although TX Buffer was emptyor the buffer contains less than 128bits of data

field.name: TBFF
field.description: TX Buffer Fill Flag: Before writing to the TX buffer, this bit should be cleared

field.name: DLPFF
field.description: Data learning is not implemented on this chip

field.name: SUSPND
field.description: When set, it signifies that a sequence is in suspended state

field.name: SPDBUF
field.description: Suspended Buffer: Provides the suspended buffer number. Valid only when SUSPND is set to 1'b1

field.name: DATLFT
field.description: Data left: Provides information about the amount of data left to be read in the suspended sequence

field.name: BFPTRC
field.description: Buffer Pointer Clear: 1: Clears the sequence pointer for AHB accesses as defined in QuadSPI_BFGENCR

field.name: IPPTRC
field.description: IP Pointer Clear: 1: Clears the sequence pointer for IP accesses as defined in QuadSPI_IPCR

field.name: TPADA1
field.description: Top address for Serial Flash A1. In effect, TPADxx is the first location of the next memory.

field.name: TPADA2
field.description: Top address for Serial Flash A2. In effect, TPxxAD is the first location of the next memory.

field.name: TPADB1
field.description: Top address for Serial Flash B1.In effect, TPxxAD is the first location of the next memory.

field.name: TPADB2
field.description: Top address for Serial Flash B2. In effect, TPxxAD is the first location of the next memory.

field.name: KEY
field.description: The key to lock or unlock the LUT. The KEY is 0x5AF05AF0. The read value is always 0x5AF05AF0

field.name: LOCK
field.description: Locks the LUT when the following condition is met: This register is written just after the LUTKEYLUT Key Register The LUT key register was written with 0x5AF05AF0 key

field.name: UNLOCK
field.description: Unlocks the LUT when the following two conditions are met: 1

field.name: ENABLE_CONTEXT_SWITCHING
field.description: Enable automatic context switching for the channels

field.name: ENABLE_CONTEXT_CACHING
field.description: The software must set this bit to enable the caching of contexts between the operations

field.name: GATHER_RESIDUAL_WRITES
field.description: The software must set this bit to enable the ragged writes to the unaligned buffers to be gathered between multiple write operations

field.name: PRESENT_SHA
field.description: Indicates whether the SHA1/SHA2 functions are present.

field.name: PRESENT_CRYPTO
field.description: Indicates whether the crypto (cipher/hash) functions are present.

field.name: CLKGATE
field.description: This bit must be set to zero for a normal operation

field.name: SFTRST
field.description: Set this bit to zero to enable a normal DCP operation

field.name: IRQ
field.description: Indicates which channels have pending interrupt requests

field.name: READY_CHANNELS
field.description: Indicates which channels are ready to proceed with a transfer (the active channel is also included)

field.name: OTP_KEY_READY
field.description: When set, it indicates that the OTP key is shifted from the fuse block and is ready for use.

field.name: ENABLE_CHANNEL
field.description: Setting a bit in this field enables the DMA channel associated with it

field.name: HIGH_PRIORITY_CHANNEL
field.description: Setting a bit in this field causes the corresponding channel to have high-priority arbitration

field.name: CH0_IRQ_MERGED
field.description: Indicates that the interrupt for channel 0 must be merged with the other interrupts on the shared dcp_irq interrupt

field.name: NUM_KEYS
field.description: Encoded value indicating the number of key-storage locations implemented in the design

field.name: NUM_CHANNELS
field.description: Encoded value indicating the number of channels implemented in the design

field.name: DISABLE_UNIQUE_KEY
field.description: Write to a 1 to disable the per-device unique key

field.name: DISABLE_DECRYPT
field.description: Write to 1 to disable the decryption

field.name: CIPHER_ALGORITHMS
field.description: One-hot field indicating which cipher algorithms are available

field.name: HASH_ALGORITHMS
field.description: One-hot field indicating which hashing features are implemented in the hardware

field.name: INDEX
field.description: Key index pointer. The valid indices are 0-[number_keys].

field.name: DATA
field.description: Word 0 data for the key. This is the least-significant word.

field.name: INTERRUPT
field.description: Reflects whether the channel must issue an interrupt upon the completion of the packet.

field.name: DECR_SEMAPHORE
field.description: Reflects whether the channel's semaphore must be decremented at the end of the current operation

field.name: CHAIN
field.description: Reflects whether the next command pointer register must be loaded into the channel's current descriptor pointer

field.name: CHAIN_CONTIGUOUS
field.description: Reflects whether the next packet's address is located following this packet's payload.

field.name: ENABLE_MEMCOPY
field.description: Reflects whether the selected hashing function should be enabled for this operation.

field.name: ENABLE_CIPHER
field.description: Reflects whether the selected cipher function must be enabled for this operation.

field.name: ENABLE_HASH
field.description: Reflects whether the selected hashing function must be enabled for this operation.

field.name: ENABLE_BLIT
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP must perform a blit operation

field.name: CIPHER_ENCRYPT
field.description: When the cipher block is enabled, this bit indicates whether the operation is encryption or decryption

field.name: CIPHER_INIT
field.description: Reflects whether the cipher block must load the initialization vector from the payload for this operation

field.name: OTP_KEY
field.description: Reflects whether a hardware-based key must be used

field.name: PAYLOAD_KEY
field.description: When set, it indicates the payload contains the key

field.name: HASH_INIT
field.description: Reflects whether the current hashing block is the initial block in the hashing operation, so the hash registers must be initialized before the operation

field.name: HASH_TERM
field.description: Reflects whether the current hashing block is the final block in the hashing operation, so the hash padding must be applied by the hardware

field.name: CHECK_HASH
field.description: Reflects whether the calculated hash value must be compared to the hash provided in the payload.

field.name: HASH_OUTPUT
field.description: When the hashing is enabled, this bit controls whether the input or output data is hashed.

field.name: CONSTANT_FILL
field.description: When this bit is set (MEMCOPY and BLIT modes only), the DCP simply fills the destination buffer with the value found in the source address field

field.name: TEST_SEMA_IRQ
field.description: This bit is used to test the channel semaphore transition to 0. FOR TEST USE ONLY!

field.name: KEY_BYTESWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine swaps the key bytes (big-endian key).

field.name: KEY_WORDSWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine swaps the key words (big-endian key).

field.name: INPUT_BYTESWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine byteswaps the input data (big-endian data).

field.name: INPUT_WORDSWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine wordswaps the input data (big-endian data).

field.name: OUTPUT_BYTESWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine byteswaps the output data (big-endian data).

field.name: OUTPUT_WORDSWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine wordswaps the output data (big-endian data).

field.name: CIPHER_MODE
field.description: Cipher mode selection field. Reflects the mode of operation for the cipher operations.

field.name: CIPHER_CFG
field.description: Cipher configuration bits. Optional configuration bits are required for the ciphers.

field.name: COUNT
field.description: Byte count register. This value is the working value and updates as the operation proceeds.

field.name: ADDR
field.description: This regiser reflects the payload pointer for the current control packet.

register.name: CH0CMDPTR
register.description: DCP channel 0 command pointer address register

field.name: ADDR
field.description: Pointer to the descriptor structure to be processed for channel 0.

field.name: INCREMENT
field.description: The value written to this field is added to the semaphore count in an atomic way such that the simultaneous software adds and DCP hardware substracts happening on the same clock are protected

field.name: VALUE
field.description: This read-only field shows the current (instantaneous) value of the semaphore counter.

field.name: HASH_MISMATCH
field.description: This bit indicates that a hashing check operation mismatched for the control packets that enable the HASH_CHECK bit

field.name: ERROR_SETUP
field.description: This bit indicates that the hardware detected an invalid programming configuration (such as a buffer length that is not a multiple of the natural data size for the operation)

field.name: ERROR_PACKET
field.description: This bit indicates that a bus error occurred when reading the packet or payload, or when writing the status back to the packet payload

field.name: ERROR_SRC
field.description: This bit indicates that a bus error occurred when reading from the source buffer

field.name: ERROR_DST
field.description: This bit indicates that a bus error occurred when storing to the destination buffer

field.name: ERROR_PAGEFAULT
field.description: This bit indicates that a page fault occurred while converting a virtual address to a physical address

field.name: ERROR_CODE
field.description: Indicates the additional error codes for some of the error conditions

enumeratedValue.description: Error signalled because the control packet specifies an invalid mode select (for instance, blit + hash)
